faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.22 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: LIQUID PRESSURE SENSOR FAULT: Liquid pressure sensor fault
checks: Liquid Pressure Sensor shorted or open - 0vDC = Shorted - 4.99vDC = Open Liquid Pressure Sensor out of range - Compare DC volt value of sensor to chart in literature No output voltage from control board - With sensor disconnected, 5vDC should be measured on control board
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Normal. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 113.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.23 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: PERSONALITY MODULE DATA CORRUPT: The primary copy of the Personality Module (PM) data file is corrupt but the local copy previously loaded is good System will continue to operate with this error but a fault will be displayed on user interface
checks: Replace PM PM could be corrupted due to power surge or damaged due to faulty field wiring
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Normal. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 114.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.23 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

checks: Outdoor unit is not a rated match with indoor unit See AHRI Ratings for proper system match-ups

faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.23 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: PERSONALITY MODULE BLOWER HP/OEM MISMATCH: Blower horsepower does not match blower specifications stored in the indoor Personality Module (PM) data file This error will prevent system operation on most models
checks: Incorrect blower motor horsepower for unit applied Incorrect PM for unit applied - If the blower motor and PM are correct, replace the blower motor
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Critical. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 114.02' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.23 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: PERSONALITY MODULE MISSING - DEVICE OPERATIONAL: Personality Module (PM) missing or not properly seated with good local copy System will continue to operate with this error but a fault will be displayed on comfort control
checks: PM is not connected or connected but not seated Disconnect power, reconnect PM, then reapply power to unit; if error does not clear replace PM
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 114.03' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.23 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: PERSONALITY MODULE CORRUPT - DEVICE OPERATIONAL: The primary copy of the Personality Module (PM) data file is corrupt but the local copy previously loaded is good System will continue to operate with this error but a fault will be displayed on user interface
checks: Replace PM PM could be corrupted due to power surge or damaged due to faulty field wiring
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Normal. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 114.04' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.23 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: PERSONALITY MODULE CORRUPT - DEVICE NOT OPERATIONAL: Corrupted primary and secondary copy of the Personality Module (PM) data files This error will prevent system operation on most models
checks: Replace PM PM could be corrupted due to power surge or damaged due to faulty field wiring
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Critical. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 114.05' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.24 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: PERSONALITY MODULE MISSING - DEVICE NOT OPERATIONAL: Personality Module (PM) missing or not properly seated, no local copy This error will prevent system operation on most models
checks: PM is not connected or connected but not seated Disconnect power, reconnect PM, then reapply power to unit; if error does not clear replace PM
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Critical. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 114.06' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.24 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: PERSONALITY MODULE BLOWER HP/OEM MISMATCH - DEVICE NOT OPERATIONAL: Blower horsepower does not match blower specifications stored in the indoor Personality Module (PM) data file This error will prevent system operation on most models
checks: Motor HP is greater than the PM value. Verify that PM model number matches the unit model and that motor matches the nameplate value.
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 114.07' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.24 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: PERSONALITY MODULE FAULT: Control board is unable to read or write to PM Module
checks: Remove PM from control board and cycle power **If alarm clears, replace PM **Replace control board and PM if alarm remains
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Normal. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 115.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.24 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: PERSONALITY MODULE FAULT: Corrupt or missing Personality Module
checks: Incompatible USB connection, such as plugging in a phone to charge the battery or using a USB storage device over 128 GB. **If alert is populated with PM in place; replace the PM
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Normal. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 115.01' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.24 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: PERSONALITY MODULE FAULT: Software upgrade began, but upgrade failed **OD unit will continue operation with old software build
checks: Corrupt software file or USB storage device removed during upgrade process **Reload software to USB storage device and reload software to AOC
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Normal. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 115.03' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.24 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: ELECTRIC HEAT CONFIGURATION FAULT: Number of electric heat stages originally discovered by the heat detection circuit is different than the number of heat stages reporting
checks: TAM9 / TEM8 Indoor Units - Electric heat is configured in the thermostat but not in the airflow control (AFC) and the thermostat has an active call for electric heat. Configure TAM9/TEM8 airflow control (AFC) for correct electric heat size (kw) selected from the CDA or 7-segment on the AFC control. - Electric heat is configured in the thermostat for more stages than what is configured in the airflow control (AFC) and the thermostat has an active call for electric heat. Verify the number of electric heat stages in the thermostat matches the configured electric heat size (kw) selected from the CDA or 7-segment on the AFC control. TAM8 / AAM8 Indoor Units - This error cannot occur unless a new unprogrammed EHC has been installed and the KW jumper position is on PARK. Set KW jumper to match the model number CLII / AccuLink Units Only - Open TCO or heater contactor circuit Number of electric heat banks has changed since start-up
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Normal. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 123.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.25 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: INPUT AC VOLTAGE IS TOO LOW: Supply voltage is below 24v while under a load
checks: Verify transformer sizing - 50va for furnace applications - 75va for air handler applications
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 125.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.25 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: EQUIPMENT CHANGE ALERT: Equipment reporting does not match the equipment originally discovered Access the Summary Table in the Diagnostic tab to get a list of discovered communicating components and their status
checks: For no equipment change: Equipment had power flicker that caused control not to report on the communicating bus. Cycle power to each piece of equipment that went missing on the bus. For equipment change: Access the Summary Table in the Diagnostic tab to get a list of discovered communicating components and their status - If a communicating component is offline and is not connected to the communicating bus, select and remove from list - If a communicating component is offline and is connected to the communicating bus, check for voltage between D & B at that component - 12vDC = good communication - 16vDC = loss of communication Pressing "Restore Factory Defaults" will erase all communicating components from memory and rediscover only the components that are currently reporting - Pressing the "Restore Factory Defaults" button will reset all control settings back to the original setting
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Critical. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 126.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.25 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: 24V COMMUNICATION MISMATCH: Mode has been set incorrectly on User Interface
checks: Comfort control mode on the furnace user interface is set for 24v when installed with communicating comfort control If installed as part of a communicating system, the comfort control mode must be set to communicating (COMM)
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Critical. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 139.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.26 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: COMPRESSOR HEAT AND INDOOR HEAT CONFLICT: The Relay Panel is sensing voltage on "Y" and "W" outside a call for defrost Only indoor heat will be allowed when this alert is active
checks: Cycle power to system and alert will clear
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 140.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.26 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: COMPRESSOR HEAT AND INDOOR HEAT CONFLICT: The Relay Panel switch is in the normal position but a heat pump and gas/oil indoor unit are installed Alert will not be given until an active call for defrost
checks: The "Dual Fuel" switch position and equipment selected in Installer Setup do not match The switch position is only read at power-up; if the switch position is changed, a power cycle of the Relay panel is required The position of the switch is not being recognized; replace the Relay Panel
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 140.01' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.26 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: HARDWARE CONFIGURATION CONFLICT WITH DEMAND: The Relay Panel switch is in the dual fuel position but the control is requesting compressor heat and indoor heat at the same time Only indoor heat will be allowed when this alert is active
checks: The "Dual Fuel" switch position and equipment selected in Installer Setup do not match The switch position is only read at power-up; if the switch position is changed, a power cycle of the Relay panel is required
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 140.02' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.26 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: HEATING ELEMENT OPEN: The EHC has detected that an element or NTCO has opened
checks: Follow troubleshooting flowchart in heater Service Facts to determine if an element or NTCO is open and replace Check for low airflow caused by restricted return air, dirty filter, blower wheel, or coil
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Normal. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 152.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.26 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: CYCLING LIMIT OPEN: The EHC has detected that the CTCO has tripped 6 times within the same heating cycle
checks: Check for low airflow caused by restricted return air, dirty filter, blower wheel, or coil
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 153.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.26 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: CYCLING LIMIT OPEN: The EHC has detected that the CTCO has tripped with no airflow demand
checks: Check for low airflow caused by restricted return air, dirty filter, blower wheel, or coil Cycle power to the air handler to clear the alert.
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Normal. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 153.01' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.26 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: ELECTRIC HEAT LOCKOUT FOR NO/ LOW AIRFLOW: The EHC has been locked out because the minimum airflow request has not been met
checks: Controls prior to CNT06726 and CNT07015 - Cycle power to the system. If alert does not clear, contact your FSR. Controls CNT06726, CNT07015, and later - Minimum 60%-70% airflow for electric heat cannot be met - Verify external static pressure/airflow table and compare to minimum airflow listed in Service Facts
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Critical. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 154.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.27 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: LOW AIRFLOW IS LIMITING ELECTRIC HEAT STAGES: The EHC is limiting the amount of electric heat due to inadequate airflow
checks: Controls prior to CNT06726 and CNT07015 - Cycle power to the system - If alert does not clear, contact your FSR. Controls CNT06726, CNT07015, and later - Minimum 60%-70% airflow for electric heat cannot be met - Verify external static pressure/airflow table and compare to minimum airflow listed in Service Facts
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 154.01' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.27 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: EEV MOTOR FAULT: The indoor EEV motor fault has been detected for 8 consecutive times
checks: EEV motor windings or the connecting harness are bad Verify that motor resistance matches Service Facts literature
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 155.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.27 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: EEV MOTOR FAULT: The indoor EEV motor winding has been detected to be open or shorted
checks: EEV motor windings or the connecting harness are bad Verify that motor resistance matches Service Facts literature
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 155.01' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.27 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: EEV MOTOR FAULT: The OD EEV electric coil has an open or intermittent short circuit. Only cooling operation is allowed (no compressor heating operation)
checks: EEV motor coil open or shorted Verify that motor resistance matches Service Facts literature
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 155.02' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.27 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: EEV MOTOR CURRENT/VOLTAGE OUT OF RANGE: EEV motor current and/or voltage values are out of range. Heating operation in limp mode (compressor will run fixed speed)
checks: Low outdoor ambient (problem should resolve when outdoor ambient rises) EEV motor windings or the connecting harness are bad - Verify that motor resistance matches Service Facts literature
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Normal. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 155.03' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.27 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: HIGH INDOOR SUPERHEAT ERROR: Superheat above 30 degrees has been detected from the indoor unit for 5 consecutive cooling cycles System operation is allowed
checks: Low refrigerant charge Restricted liquid line, filter/drier Indoor EEV motor not seated properly on the valve Indoor Coil temp or Gas temp sensor out of range - Compare resistance value of sensors to chart in literature
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 156.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.27 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: HIGH SUPERHEAT ERROR: Superheat above 50 degrees has been detected by the outdoor unit for more than 20 minutes in cooling or heating mode
checks: Low refrigerant charge Restricted liquid line or filter/drier Suction temperature sensor out of calibration - Check calibration, location and proper mounting, and insulation
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Normal. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 156.01' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.28 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: INTERNAL CONDENSATE FLOAT SWITCH ACTIVATED: Internal condensate switch has been activated
checks: Check condensate piping and drain pan for restrictions
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Critical. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 157.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.28 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: INDOOR COIL FROST PROTECTION: The indoor evaporator temperature sensor has been below freezing for 20 consecutive minutes (compressor shut down for 5 minutes)
checks: Low airflow Low refrigerant charge Indoor ET sensor out of calibration Low outdoor ambient conditions (the fault would be normal in this case)
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 158.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.28 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: AIRFLOW CONTROL UNIT BUS COMM ERROR: Airflow control (AFC) has lost communication with the expansion valve control (EVC) and, for TAM8 only, aux heat control (EHC/HHC)
checks: TAM9 Indoor Unit - Ohm wiring harness between J2 of the AFC and J2 of the EVC - Good continuity = 0 ohms TAM8 / AAM8 Indoor Units - Ohm wiring harness between J2 of the AFC and J5 of the Distribution board for continuity - Good continuity = 0 ohms All Indoor Units - Cycle power to the unit. If the UNIT LED on the AFC does not flash once every 4 seconds replace AFC
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Critical. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 159.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.28 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: ELECTRIC HEAT CONTROL UNIT BUS COMM ERROR: Airflow control (AFC) has lost communication with the electric heat control (EHC)
checks: Ohm wiring harness between the EHC and J9 of the Distribution board for continuity Good continuity = 0 ohms
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 159.01' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.28 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: HYDRONIC HEAT CONTROL UNIT BUS COMM ERROR: Airflow control (AFC) has lost communication with the hydronic heat control (HHC)
checks: Ohm wiring harness between the HHC and J9 of the Distribution board for continuity Good continuity = 0 ohms
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 159.02' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.28 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: EXPANSION VALVE CONTROL UNIT BUS COMM ERROR: Airflow control (AFC) has lost communication with the expansion valve control (EVC)
checks: TAM9 Indoor Unit - Ohm wiring harness between J2 of the EVC and J2 of the AFC for continuity Good continuity = 0 ohms TAM8 / AAM8 Indoor Units - Ohm wiring harness between J2 of the EVC and J4 of the Distribution board for continuity Good continuity = 0 ohms
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 159.03' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.28 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: INDOOR DISPLAY ASSEMBLY (CDA) COMM ERROR: Indoor display assembly (CDA) communication error
checks: TAM9 Indoor Unit - Ohm wiring harness between display and J9 of the AFC for continuity Good continuity = 0 ohms TAM8 / AAM8 Indoor Units - Ohm wiring harness between the display assembly and the distribution board for continuity Good continuity = 0 ohms
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Normal. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 159.04' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.29 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: OUTDOOR DISPLAY ASSEMBLY (CDA) COMM ERROR: Outdoor display assembly (CDA) communication error
checks: Check wire assembly between Display Assembly and IVSC board
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Normal. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 159.05' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.29 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: ID EEV CONFIGURATION FAULT: The EVC sensor type does not match the Personality Module (PM)
checks: Cycle power to the system. If alert does not clear, replace the EVC
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 160.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.29 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: EEV COIL TEMPERATURE SENSOR ERROR: Indoor coil temperature sensor reading is out of range; indicating an open or shorted condition
checks: Verify that DC voltage readings and resistance match Service Facts literature. See sensor troubleshooting flowchart in SF - Check sensor voltage and resistance - Check harness and connector for open or short
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 161.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.29 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: EEV GAS TEMPERATURE SENSOR ERROR: Indoor gas temperature sensor reading is out of range; indicating an open or shorted condition
checks: Verify that DC voltage readings and resistance match Service Facts literature. See sensor troubleshooting flowchart in SF - Check sensor voltage and resistance - Check harness and connector for open or short
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 161.01' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.29 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: SATURATION TEMPERATURE SENSOR ERROR: Indoor saturation temperature sensor reading is out of range; indicating an open or shorted condition
checks: Verify that DC voltage readings and resistance match Service Facts literature. See sensor troubleshooting flowchart in SF - Check sensor voltage and resistance - Check harness and connector for open or short
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 161.02' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.29 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: EVC CONTROL FAILURE: Internal control error detected on the indoor EVC
checks: Remove EEV motor harness and cycle power. - If internal control error goes away, check EEV motor resistance and harness condition - If error persists, replace EVC See troubleshooting flowchart in Service Facts

faultCodes.meaning: SUCTION PRESSURE SENSOR FAULT: Outdoor suction pressure transducer is missing, open, shorted or below the range Missing, open or under range will hard lockout Over range: Software version 3.X and higher will continually soft lockout until the sensor gets within range
checks: Suction Pressure Sensor shorted, open or failed - 0vDC = Open/Failed 4.99vDC = Shorted Suction Pressure Sensor out of range - Compare DC volt value of sensor to chart in literature No output voltage from control board - With sensor disconnected, 5vDC should be measured on control board System is off and ambient temperature indoor and outdoor is above 112°F. Will cause a hard lockout on outdoor software version 2.0 or lower.
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Critical. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 174.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).

faultCodes.meaning: LIMP ALONG MODE: Outdoor Software Version 3.X or higher: - Limp mode has been triggered by sensor fault; look for sensor error (compressor speed fixed to a constant value) Outdoor Software Version 1.0 & 2.0: - Limp mode has been triggered by high or low superheat for at least 20 minutes or by sensor fault; look for sensor error (compressor speed fixed to a constant value)
checks: Sensor(s) faulted (out of range) - Dome temperature sensor (limp mode for heating only) - Suction temperature sensor (limp mode for heating only) - Ambient temperature sensor (limp mode for heating and cooling) - Indoor coil temperature sensor for EEV control (limp mode for cooling only) Possible refrigerant pressure or airflow problem
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Normal. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 175.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.33 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: SUCTION PRESSURE RANGE CUTOUT / LIMP MODE: For Outdoor Software Version 3.X or higher: - Compressor temporarily disabled due to the suction pressure transducer being out of range on the high end (above approx. 375 psig). Compressor will not be allowed to operate until pressure drops below approx. 365 psig. For Outdoor Software Version 1.0 & 2.0: - Compressor runs fixed speed due to high or low superheat in heating mode for an extended time period
checks: For Outdoor Software Version 3.X and higher: - Suction pressure transducer is failed or out of range. If ambient temperature is above 112°F, allow ambient to cool below 110°F to see if transducer comes back in range and clears alert. For Outdoor Software Version 1.0 & 2.0: - Check suction temperature sensor location and proper mounting and insulation - Check suction temperature sensor calibration - Check pressure transducer calibration - For repeated alert occurrences, update to the latest Outdoor Unit VSPD software
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Normal. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 175.01' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.33 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: EXCESSIVE LOW SH: Excessive low superheat (175.03) alarms
checks: Follow troubleshooting steps from the 175.03 alarms that preceeded this alarm
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Major. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 175.02' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.33 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: LIMP ALONG MODE LOW SH: Limp mode has been triggered by low superheat below 3 degrees for 20 minutes (compressor speed fixed to a constant value) 5 occurrences within approx. 10 hours will result in Excessive Low SH (175.02)
checks: Check the following sensors: - Suction temperature sensor location and proper mounting and insulation - Suction temperature sensor calibration - Pressure transducer calibration Improper refrigerant charge (check pressures against pressure curves) Low indoor air flow (verify at least 400 CFM per ton and static is below 1.0 inches at 100% air flow) 3rd party indoor coil was installed with system (3rd party coils not allowed with VS outdoor units) OD EEV is not closing properly and flooding (run closed valve test)
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Normal. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 175.03' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.33 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: MODBUS COMMUNICATION FAILURE HARD LOCKOUT: Loss of internal communication within the Drive (hard lockout) Universal Hard Lockout (184.08) will accompany this alarm
checks: Power cycle the OD unit and check for solid earth ground (EMI) Check for a good harness connection between the AOC & Drive (for units with multiple control boards) Reprogram drive to the latest software (AOC and MOC) - Call for drive authorization if alerts continue. Drive failure.
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Critical. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 176.00' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).
faultCodes.source: Trane System Alert Guide (residential communicating systems, ERR/CFG/SOP alerts), 08/05/2020, p.34 (Possible cause / corrective action column copied into checks)

faultCodes.meaning: MODBUS COMMUNICATION FAILURE: Loss of internal communication within the Drive (5 minute soft lockout) 10 occurrences within approx. 10 hours will result in Modbus Communication Failure Hard Lockout (176.00) and Universal Hard Lockout (184.08)
checks: Check for good grounding to minimize EMI Ensure harness has a good connection between AOC and Drive
faultCodes.notes: System Alert Guide severity: Normal. Shown on the thermostat as 'Err 176.01' (XL824/XL850/XL1050/UX360).

checks: For models 4TWV, 4TTV, 4A6V & 4A7V: Run drive diagnostics and consult Variable Speed Outdoor Unit Technical Service Manual for diagnosis - Call for tech support, record failure mode for warranty claim before replacing drive For model 4TWL90: High load condition in cooling Compressor started at end of preheat cycle (normal operation)

ledPatterns.pattern: Amber COMM LED flashing once per device (slow flash)
ledPatterns.meaning: Device count: the amber COMM LED on each communicating board flashes once per connected communicating device.
checks: Count the flashes and compare with the number of communicating devices installed (thermostat, indoor, outdoor, zone panel...).

ledPatterns.pattern: Amber COMM LED rapid/fast flash (about 5 per second)
ledPatterns.meaning: Loss of communication on the data bus.
checks: Check R, D, B, (C) wiring and polarity; 12-13 VDC between D and B at the indoor unit is normal (CFG.001.09); about 16 VDC = loss of communication (ERR.126.00 notes).

diagnosticTips: Data bus check: 12-13 VDC between D and B at the indoor unit is normal (CFG.001.09). ERR.126.00 notes: 12 VDC = good, 16 VDC = loss of communication.

ERR.126.00 EQUIPMENT CHANGE ALERT (Critical): if no equipment was changed, a power flicker probably stopped a control reporting; cycle power to each piece of equipment. If equipment was changed, run Restore Factory Defaults to rediscover.
ERR.125.00 (Major): input 24 VAC below 24 V under load. Transformer sizing for communicating systems: 50 VA with a furnace, 75 VA with an air handler.

Thermostat logs: XL824 Service Menu > Diagnostics > Current Alerts / Alert History (30 days), can be saved to USB (18-HD72D1-11F-EN). Link UX360: Menu > System Info > Alerts (CNTR-SVN001A-EN). On the XL824 installer menu do not press Save unless the change is meant to be permanent.
XL824 icons: CRITICAL alerts flash a red icon (loss of heating/cooling); MAJOR = reduced function; MINOR alerts are shown only under Diagnostics (18-HD72D1-11F-EN).
'Restore Factory Defaults' rediscovers all communicating equipment but resets all control settings to factory values; record settings first.
Conversions: BAYLINK001 converts ComfortLink II/AccuLink systems to Link (18-HH38D1-1A-EN); kit BACS9V2CA22MUAA converts an S9V2-VS (revision B and later) furnace to Link (FNR-SVN001A-EN).
Variable-speed outdoor alerts (79, 80, 88, 176-189) are described in more detail, with the Display Assembly text and unit action, in platform trane_res_vs_outdoor_ivsc.

controls.name: Trane / American Standard variable-speed outdoor unit alerts (IVSC inverter drive + Display Assembly; 4TTV/4TWV, 4A7V/4A6V, 5TTV/5TWV Link)
controls.description: Alert codes of the inverter variable-speed outdoor units: Trane 4TTV0/4TWV0/4TTV8/4TWV8 (XV-series; 5TTV/5TWV are the Link versions) and American Standard 4A7V0/4A6V0, 4A7V8/4A6V8 (Platinum, AccuLink). Code = alert.sub-alarm as on the thermostat ('Err 80.01' = 80.01). Notes give the outdoor Display Assembly (CDA) text and what the thermostat shows ('Wait' icon, Err code, or N/A = technician log only). The Service Facts give no severity class: where the same number is in the System Alert Guide its severity is used, otherwise severity is derived from the unit-action column (stated in each entry's notes). likelyCauses = 'Likely causes' column, checks = the unit action on occurrence / clearance. All 119 rows of the 4T-V0-SF-1A table are included. Link (5TTV/5TWV) full alert tables are in Technical Service Manual 34-4301-01 (not obtained).

faultCodes.meaning: Control Failure: Internal control error is detected
likelyCauses: Control failure, replace IVSC
checks: On occurrence: Shutdown. Send Err code to thermostat and Fault text to CDA On clearance: Resume normal operation.
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'CTRL FLT'. Thermostat shows: Err 18.04. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.018.04 (Critical).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.19 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Temp Sensor Fault: Ambient Temperature Sensor alert
likelyCauses: Ambient Sensor out- of-range (Open/ Shorted/Missing)
checks: On occurrence: For Cooling mode, "Assume Ambient Temp" as per Limp along mode and Continue normal operation. For Heating mode, go to timed defrost. On clearance: With actual ambient temperature, continue normal operation. For Heating mode, follow demand defrost algorithm
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'AMB T SENSE'. Thermostat shows: Err 67.00. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.067.00 (Major).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.19 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Temp Sensor Fault: Coil Temperature Sensor alert
likelyCauses: Coil Sensor out-of- range (Open/ Shorted/Missing)
checks: On occurrence: For Cooling mode, continue normal operation. For heating mode, go to timed defrost. On clearance: Continue normal operation. For heating mode, revert to algorithm initiated defrost.
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'COIL T SENSE'. Thermostat shows: Err 67.01. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.067.01 (Major).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.19 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Temp Sensor Fault: External Temperature Sensor alert
likelyCauses: External Sensor out- of range (Shorted) Open/Missing revert to Ambient Sensor input
checks: On occurrence: Cooling - Normal operation On clearance: Continue normal operation

faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.19 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Temp Sensor Fault: Dome Temperature Sensor is faulted in Heating mode
likelyCauses: Dome Sensor out-of- range (Open/ Shorted/Missing)

faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.19 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Temp Sensor Fault: Suction Temperature Sensor is faulted in Cooling mode
likelyCauses: Suction Sensor out- of-range (Open/ Shorted/Missing)
checks: On occurrence: Cooling - Normal operation On clearance: Continue normal operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'SUCT T SENSE'. Thermostat shows: Err 67.06. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.067.06 (Major).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.19 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Temp Sensor Fault: Suction Temperature Sensor is faulted in Heating mode
likelyCauses: Suction Sensor out- of-range (Open/ Shorted/Missing)
checks: On occurrence: Heating - Limp along mode of constant speed (Compressor speed is limited to 2400 RPM, EEV is locked to safe position) On clearance: Ramp up to demand speed and resume normal operation.
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'SUCT T SENSE'. Thermostat shows: Err 67.07. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.067.07 (Major).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.19 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Defrost Fault: Defrost Fault A has been detected
likelyCauses: Low heat pump capacity (Inoperative compressor, loss of charge, shorted coil sensor, open ambient sensor)
checks: On occurrence: As defined in Defrost algorithm On clearance: Continue normal operation

faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.19 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Defrost Fault: Defrost Fault B or C has been detected
likelyCauses: Fault B indicates 10 defrosts terminated on time override. Fault C indicates sensor High Delta T.
checks: On occurrence: As defined in Defrost algorithm On clearance: Continue normal operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'DFT FAULT B/C'. Thermostat shows: N/A. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.068.01 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.19 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Defrost Fault: Defrost Fault A and B or A and C have been detected
likelyCauses: Within a given length of time, both faults existed
checks: On occurrence: As defined in Defrost algorithm On clearance: Continue normal operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'DFT FAULT A(B/C)'. Thermostat shows: N/A. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.068.02 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.19 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: High Pressure Monitor Fault: High pressure switch has tripped resulting in a High Pressure Short Lock Out. (HPCO limit = 650psig)
likelyCauses: Overcharged. Cooling Mode: Outdoor Fan Failure, clogged coil, recirculation, excessive high ambient, non condensable. Heating Mode: Indoor Fan Failure, clogged coil, non condensable.
checks: On occurrence: 5 min of compressor lockout and send "WAIT "to thermostat On clearance: Restart with reduced capacity. (Capacity reduced by 1/5 with each occurrence)
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'HP SHORT LO'. Thermostat shows: "Wait". Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.080.00 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.19 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: High Pressure Monitor Fault: 6 High Pressure Short Lock Out events have occurred resulting in a High Pressure Hard Lock Out. (High Pressure Limit = 650psig)
likelyCauses: Overcharged. Cooling Mode: Outdoor Fan Failure, clogged coil, recirculation, excessive high ambient, non condensable. Heating Mode: Indoor Fan Failure, clogged coil, non condensable.
checks: On occurrence: Lockout compressor operation until power cycle, No system operation On clearance: Can be cleared only on power cycle. After power cycle, the compressor shall resume normal operation.
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'HP HARD LO'. Thermostat shows: Err 80.01. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.080.01 (Critical).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.20 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: High Pressure Monitor Fault: High Pressure trip point has been exceeded and a 5 minute time out has been enforced. Restart is allowed but with reduced capacity.
likelyCauses: Overcharged. Cooling Mode: Outdoor Fan Failure, clogged coil, recirculation, excessive high ambient, non condensable. Heating Mode: Indoor Fan Failure, clogged coil, non condensable.
checks: On occurrence: On restart, after short lockout, the compressor shall operate at reduced capacity at which point this alert is declared. (Message on Tstat informing of reduced capacity) Note: Recover reduced capacity with each 2 hour runtime window without an HPCO trip. On clearance: Normal operation resumes.
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'HP RED RPS'. Thermostat shows: "Wait". Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.080.02 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.20 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Ground fault: Grounding issue from output of the drive. If the sum of all three currents exceeds 10 amp to ground
likelyCauses: Burnt winding, faulty current sensor, internal board short, pinched compressor lead (shorted). Run Drive Test. (GoTo "Compressor Verification" troubleshooting flow chart)
checks: On occurrence: Emergency shutdown. Drive will protect itself. On clearance: Can be cleared only on power cycle. After power cycle, the compressor shall resume normal operation.
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'GND FAULT LO'. Thermostat shows: Err 88.01. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.088.01 (Critical).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.20 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Communi- cation Busy Fault: Communication busy
likelyCauses: R & B to thermostat reversed polarity
checks: On occurrence: CLII bus must go idle. Continue to operate normally On clearance: Resume normal operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'SYS COM BUSY'. Thermostat shows: Err 90.02. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.090.02 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.20 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Communi- cation Fault: Loss of Heat/Cool demand message
likelyCauses: Open/Shorted Data line
checks: On occurrence: Shutdown if Heat/Cool demand message not received for 3 reporting intervals. On clearance: Resume normal operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'SYS COM ERR'. Thermostat shows: Err 91.02. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.091.02 (Critical).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.20 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Communi- cation Fault: Loss of Bit Master
likelyCauses: Bit Master Control Fault
checks: On occurrence: Shutdown On clearance: Resume normal operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'NO SYS CLK'. Thermostat shows: Err 91.03. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.091.03 (Critical).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.20 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: External Shutdown Fault: External shutdown switch is Active and input at T3 to T4 is open
likelyCauses: External Load Shed device is active with external switch configured to Active and input at T3 to T4 is open
checks: On occurrence: Compressor cooling operation shall not be allowed. On clearance: Resume normal operation. Cooling operation allowed.
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'EXT SW OPEN'. Thermostat shows: "Load Shed". Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.106.01 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.20 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Bad or Missing PM: PM data corrupt
likelyCauses: PM Error
checks: On occurrence: Continue normal operation On clearance: Continue normal operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'PM DATA ERR'. Thermostat shows: N/A. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.114.00 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.20 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Bad or Missing PM: PM missing with good local copy
likelyCauses: PM Error
checks: On occurrence: Continue normal operation On clearance: Continue normal operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'PM MISSING'. Thermostat shows: Err 114.03. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.114.03 (Major).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.20 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Bad or Missing PM: Bad data in PM with good local copy
likelyCauses: PM error
checks: On occurrence: Continue normal operation On clearance: Continue normal operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'PM UNIT ERR'. Thermostat shows: N/A. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.114.04 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.20 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Bad or Missing PM: Bad data in PM with no local copy
likelyCauses: PM Error
checks: On occurrence: Shutdown. No compressor operation until a good PM is inserted. On clearance: Resume normal operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'PM MEM ERR'. Thermostat shows: Err 114.05. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.114.05 (Critical).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.20 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Bad or Missing PM: PM bad or missing with no local copy
likelyCauses: PM Error
checks: On occurrence: Shutdown. No compressor operation until a good PM is inserted. On clearance: Resume normal operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'PM MISSING'. Thermostat shows: Err 114.06. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.114.06 (Critical).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.20 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Outdoor EEV Motor Fault: The OD EEV electric coil has an open or intermittent short circuit.
likelyCauses: EEV motor coil open or shorted
checks: On occurrence: Can not run in Heating mode, Can run in Cooling mode On clearance: Power cycle
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'EEV MTR ERR'. Thermostat shows: Err 155.02. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.155.02 (Major).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.20 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: System Low Charge Fault: High Superheat occurrence of 35 degrees or more has been detected for more than 60 minutes.
likelyCauses: System low charge, liquid line restriction, sensor calibration
checks: On occurrence: High Superheat occurrences On clearance: Superheat Change occurs and allows control within the EEV range of operation. (Superheat target is 10 degrees +/- 4)
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'LOW CHARGE'. Thermostat shows: N/A. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.156.01 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.21 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Unit Bus Fault: Display Assembly communication error
likelyCauses: Wire assembly between Display Assembly and IVSC board
checks: On occurrence: OD Continue normal operation On clearance: Continue normal operation. Technician interface available
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'IPC3 COM ERR'. Thermostat shows: Err 159.05. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.159.05 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.21 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Outdoor EEV Valve Migrated Open: EEV migrated to open position but superheat is not at the desired set point. Valve is not responding to a change in position.
likelyCauses: Possible stuck valve or sensor(s) out of calibration
checks: On occurrence: The valve is not responding to a change in position, EEV supposedly opened fully and no change to accommodate superheat occurred. On clearance: Superheat Change occurs and allows control within the EEV range of operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'EEV OPEN ERR'. Thermostat shows: N/A. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.164.02 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.21 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Outdoor EEV Valve Migrated Closed: EEV migrated to closed position but superheat is not at the desired set point. Valve is not responding to a change in position.
likelyCauses: Possible stuck valve or sensor(s) out of calibration
checks: On occurrence: The valve is not responding to a change in position, EEV supposedly closed fully and no change to accommodate superheat occurred. On clearance: Superheat Change occurs and allows control within the EEV range of operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'EEV CLSE ERR'. Thermostat shows: N/A. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.164.03 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.21 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Low Superheat Error: Low supper heat (less than 3 degrees)has been detected for more than 60 minutes
likelyCauses: Possible stuck valve, sensor(s) out of calibration, low airflow, overcharge, check valve leaking.
checks: On occurrence: Low Superheat occurrences On clearance: Superheat Change occurs and allows control within the EEV range of operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'LO SUPERHEAT'. Thermostat shows: N/A. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.165.01 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.21 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Low Superheat Error: EEV valve closed and still flooding
likelyCauses: Possible stuck valve, sensor(s) out of calibration, low airflow, overcharge, check valve leaking.
checks: On occurrence: Low Superheat with EEV closed On clearance: Superheat Change occurs and allows control within the EEV range of operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'LO SUPERHEAT'. Thermostat shows: N/A. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.166.01 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.21 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Key fault: Display Assembly has a stuck key
likelyCauses: Faulty Display Assembly
checks: On occurrence: OD continue normal operation. CDA shall quit generating key events and will stay on same screen till timeout and then jump to default screen. On clearance: Continue normal operation. Technician interface available
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'KEY FAULT'. Thermostat shows: N/A. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.172.01 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.21 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Suction Pressure Sensor Fault: Pressure transducer is missing, open, shorted or out of range.
likelyCauses: Wiring or component failure. (System under vacuum or suction pressure over 500psig)
checks: On occurrence: Shutdown and enter a hard lockout. Compressor locked out until power cycle and requires service call. On clearance: Power cycle. After power cycle, the compressor shall resume normal operation.
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'SUCT P SENSE'. Thermostat shows: Err 174.00. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.174.00 (Critical).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.21 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Limp Along Mode: Loss of sensor reading. Limit Compressor Speed to a constant value.
likelyCauses: Sensor Faulted (out of range). Dome temp, suction temp, ambient temp, ID temp sensor (EEV in safe mode).
checks: On occurrence: Loss of sensor reading. Limit Compressor Speed to a constant value. On clearance: Ramp up to demand speed (normal operation)
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'LIMP MODE'. Thermostat shows: Err 175.00. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.175.00 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.21 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Limp Along Mode: Shutdown. Can’t start system without Service being called. Send error to thermostat and alert menu in CDA
likelyCauses: Sensor Faulted (out of range). Dome temp, suction temp, ambient temp, ID temp sensor (EEV in safe mode).
checks: On occurrence: Loss of multiple sensor readings. Shutdown is called from limp along algorithm On clearance: Can be cleared only on power cycle. After power cycle, the compressor shall resume normal operation.
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'LIMP MOD LO'. Thermostat shows: Err 175.01. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.175.01 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.21 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Modbus Communi- cation Failure: Loss of internal communication within the Drive.
likelyCauses: Loss of internal communication within the Drive. On a persistent 176.00 error, the technician should cycle power to the ODU. If error 176.00 returns, replace the Drive. If replacement Drive has the same issue, investigate for EMI and source.
checks: On occurrence: With communication error message, the drive must shut down. On clearance: Can be cleared only on power cycle. After power cycle, the compressor shall resume normal operation.
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'DRV COMM LO'. Thermostat shows: Err 176.00. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.176.00 (Critical).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.22 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Drive Current Failure: Internal Derate is active due to high Drive output current
likelyCauses: High load conditions.
checks: On occurrence: Compressor speed Derated. On clearance: Ramp up to demand speed (normal operation).
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'CUR DER'. Thermostat shows: N/A. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.177.00 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.22 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Drive Current Failure: Drive current is above threshold and the system is being Derated for an extended period of time.
likelyCauses: High load conditions.
checks: On occurrence: Compressor speed Derated. This alert shall be an indication of an extended Derated performance. On clearance: Ramp up to demand speed (normal operation).
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'CUR EX DER'. Thermostat shows: Err 177.01. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.177.01 (Major).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.22 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Drive Current Failure: Drive output current exceeds internal limit set for current sensor
likelyCauses: High load condition. Overcharge, dirty coil (s), low airflow, recirculation, compressor failure, Drive hardware failure (Run Drive Diagnostics).
checks: On occurrence: Emergency shutdown. Control will clear the fault and retry every 5 minutes. On clearance: Resume normal operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'SW CUR CO'. Thermostat shows: "Wait". Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.177.02 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.22 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Drive Current Failure: Drive output current exceeds internal limit set for current sensor
likelyCauses: Compressor failure (locked rotor, shorted windings), Drive hardware failure (Run Drive Diagnostics)
checks: On occurrence: Emergency shutdown. Control will clear the fault and retry every 5 minutes. On clearance: Resume normal operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'HW CUR CO'. Thermostat shows: "Wait". Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.177.03 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.22 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Drive Current Failure: 5 occurrences of HW CUR CO in 1 hour, or 15 occurrences of SW CUR CO in 1 hour. Each hour of runtime without a HW or SW cutout will reduce the total count by 1.
likelyCauses: High load conditions for 5 consecutive over current cutout periods. GoTo Drive Diagnostic Test in CDA. Also see Compressor Verification Flowchart. Choke possibly not plugged in.
checks: On occurrence: Emergency shutdown On clearance: Can be cleared only on power cycle. After power cycle, the compressor shall resume normal operation.
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'CURRENT LO'. Thermostat shows: Err 177.04. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.177.04 (Critical).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.22 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: DC Voltage Failure: DC bus voltage is greater than 480VDC
likelyCauses: PFC hardware failure. Run Drive Diagnostic Test to verify failure. Call for tech support, record failure mode for warranty claim before replacing Drive.
checks: On occurrence: Emergency shutdown. Control will clear the fault and retry every 5 minutes. On clearance: Resume normal operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'DC HI CO'. Thermostat shows: "Wait". Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.178.00 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.22 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: DC Voltage Failure: DC bus voltage is less than 220VDC
likelyCauses: Low line voltage. Verify supply voltage is between 187VAC and 253VAC
checks: On occurrence: Emergency shutdown. Control will clear the fault and retry every 5 minutes. On clearance: Resume normal operation

checks: On occurrence: Emergency shutdown. Control will clear the fault and retry every 5 minutes. On clearance: Resume normal operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'LOW VOLT CO'. Thermostat shows: Err 180.02. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.180.02 (Major).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.23 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Gate Drive Failure: Drive hardware failure alert
likelyCauses: Drive hardware failure. 10 consecutive occurrences will result in an Err 181.07
checks: On occurrence: IGBT Failure. Gate driver fault is activated. Control will clear the fault and retry every 5 minutes. On clearance: Control will clear fault when condition no longer exists, 10 occurrences of gate drive failure cause the control to trip lock, which can only be cleared with a power cycle.
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'GATE DRV CO'. Thermostat shows: Err 181.00. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.181.00 (Major).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.24 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Reverse Rotation Protection Soft Lockout: Suction Pressure has not changed at start up. Cannot execute start-up because suction pressure does not drop in the time allotted.
likelyCauses: Compressor mis- wired, Suction Pressure Sensor Failure (verify accuracy) SOV bi- passing, compressor not pumping
checks: On occurrence: Soft Lockout for 5 minutes. Send "Wait" to Thermostat On clearance: After 5 minute time out, the compressor shall resume normal operation.
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'REV ROT CO'. Thermostat shows: "Wait". Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.181.01 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.24 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Motor Phase Loss Detection: Compressor cable connection or motor winding problem. (Verify wiring and windings)
likelyCauses: Compressor cable connection or motor winding problem. (Verify wiring and windings) Run Drive Diagnostics to confirm failure mode.
checks: On occurrence: Emergency shutdown. Control will clear the fault and retry every 5 minutes. On clearance: Resume normal operation. Control will clear fault when condition no longer exists.
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'PHS LOSS CO'. Thermostat shows: Err 181.02. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.181.02 (Critical).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.24 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Reverse Rotation Protection Hard Lockout: Suction Pressure has not changed at start up. 5 Reverse Rotation Shutdowns have occurred
likelyCauses: Compressor miss- wired, Suction Pressure Sensor Failure (verify accuracy) SOV bi- passing, compressor not pumping
checks: On occurrence: Can’t start system without Service being called. Send error to thermostat and alert menu in CDA On clearance: Can be cleared only on power cycle.
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'REV ROT LO'. Thermostat shows: Err 181.03. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.181.03 (Critical).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.24 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Stall Detection: Locked Rotor Condition has been detected
likelyCauses: Locked Rotor Condition has been detected. Run Drive Diagnostics to confirm failure mode. Verify system is not grossly overcharged and that service valves are open. Replace compressor.
checks: On occurrence: Emergency shutdown. Locked Rotor. Control will clear the fault and retry every 5 minutes. On clearance: Resume normal operation. Control will clear fault when condition no longer exists.
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'STALL DET CO'. Thermostat shows: Err 181.04. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.181.04 (Major).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.24 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Gate Drive Failure Trip Lock: 10 consecutive occurrences of gate drive failure alert
likelyCauses: Drive hardware failure. Run Drive Diagnostic Test to confirm failure mode. Call for tech support, record failure mode for warranty claim before replacing Drive.
checks: On occurrence: 10 consecutive occurrences of gate drive failure On clearance: Control needs to be power cycled.
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'GATE DRV LO'. Thermostat shows: Err 181.07. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.181.07 (Critical).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.24 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Illegal Configura- tion: Improper parameters used in Personality Module
likelyCauses: Data in PM is corrupt or wrong PM installed.
checks: On occurrence: Trip lock upon occurrence On clearance: Can only be cleared with a Power Cycle
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'CONFIG ERR'. Thermostat shows: Err 181.08. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.181.08 (Critical).

faultCodes.meaning: No Motor: The compressor motor is not detected (all three windings are not detected)

checks: On occurrence: Shutdown. Send "clear alarm" message every 5 min and retry demand On clearance: Resume normal operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'NO MOTOR'. Thermostat shows: Err 181.09. Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.181.09 (Critical).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.24 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

likelyCauses: Drive is limiting compressor speed due to Inverter high temperature or high current.
checks: On occurrence: Can’t execute start-up algorithm Can’t start system for at least 5 minutes. Proceed to Normal shutdown. Send "Wait" to thermostat, send Alert to CDA home screen menu and history On clearance: Resume normal operation
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'STRT SOFT LO'. Thermostat shows: "Wait". Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.182.00 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.25 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

likelyCauses: Drive is limiting compressor speed due to Inverter high temperature or high current.
