faultCodes.meaning: Shutdown Algorithm Fault: Compressor does not come to a complete stop even after the defined time and continues to run even after control is released.
likelyCauses: Loss of internal communication. If error continues after system resets, call for tech support.
checks: On occurrence: Control is reset internally. Retry after 5 minutes. On clearance: Resume normal operation after compressor comes to a halt.
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'SHTDWN CO'. Thermostat shows: "Wait". Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.183.00 (Major).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.25 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Protection Algorithm Fault: (In cooling mode) Indoor coil freeze protection is active. Suction pressure sensor is <78psig (20F saturated) for 20 minutes.
likelyCauses: Restricted airflow, low charge, low ambient operation, restriction in refrigerant system or metering device.
checks: On occurrence: Shutdown. Soft lockout. Send "Wait" to thermostat, send Alert to CDA home screen menu and history On clearance: Resume normal operation after suction pressure is greater than 107psig (35F saturated) and compressor cutout time has elapsed. Cut Out Time = 5 minutes
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'IDCF CO'. Thermostat shows: "Wait". Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.184.00 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.25 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Protection Algorithm Fault: Compressor High Temperature Protection at High Speed- Shutdown (Dome Temp Sensor).
likelyCauses: High super heat at compressor - Low charge, restricted metering device, restricted condenser airflow in cooling mode, sensor accuracy, high indoor ambient in heat mode, (Indoor set point above 80F) (Increase ID airflow)
checks: On occurrence: Shutdown. Dome temp sensor value is 260F or higher for at least 15 seconds with compressor speed greater than 2400 RPM. Soft lockout. Send "Wait" to thermostat, send Alert to CDA home screen menu and history On clearance: Resume normal operation after cutout time has elapsed. CO=15 minutes
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'CDT HI SP CO'. Thermostat shows: "Wait". Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.184.01 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.26 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Protection Algorithm Fault: Compressor High Temperature Protection at Low Speed-Shutdown (Dome Temp Sensor).
likelyCauses: High super heat at compressor - Low charge, restricted metering device, restricted condenser airflow in cooling mode, sensor accuracy, high indoor ambient in heat mode, (Indoor set point above 80F) (Increase ID airflow)
checks: On occurrence: Shutdown. Dome temp sensor value is 260F or higher for at least 15 seconds with compressor speed less than 2400 RPM. Soft lockout. Send "Wait" to thermostat, send Alert to CDA home screen menu and history On clearance: Resume normal operation after compressor cutout time has elapsed. CO=15 minutes
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'CDT LO SP CO'. Thermostat shows: "Wait". Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.184.02 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.26 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Protection Algorithm Fault: Low Suction Pressure Protection in Cooling Mode. Less than 50 PSIG
likelyCauses: Low charge, EEV pump down, restriction. Pressure transducer calibration.
checks: On occurrence: Shutdown. Soft lockout. Send "Wait" to thermostat, send Alert to CDA home screen menu and history On clearance: Resume normal operation after compressor cutout time has elapsed. CO=5 minutes
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'LSPP CLG CO'. Thermostat shows: "Wait". Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.184.03 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.26 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Protection Algorithm Fault: Low Suction Pressure Protection in Heating Mode. Less than 13 PSIG
likelyCauses: Low charge, EEV pump down, restriction. Pressure transducer calibration. Extremely low outdoor ambient (ODT less than minus 10F)
checks: On occurrence: Shutdown. Soft lockout. Send "Wait" to thermostat, send Alert to CDA home screen menu and history On clearance: Resume normal operation after compressor cutout time has elapsed. CO=5 minutes
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'LSPP HTG CO'. Thermostat shows: "Wait". Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.184.04 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.26 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Protection Algorithm Fault: Maximum Current Low Speed Protection. High compressor load during low speed operation.
likelyCauses: System operating under temperature extremes. Possible Derate condition, high compression ratio, damaged compressor (bearings/scroll set galled). Check for high dome temperature alert in previous history.
checks: On occurrence: Shutdown. Soft lockout. Send "Wait" to thermostat, send Alert to CDA home screen menu and history On clearance: Resume normal operation after compressor cutout time has elapsed. CO=5 minutes
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'MCLP CO'. Thermostat shows: "Wait". Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.184.05 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.26 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Protection Algorithm Fault: In the compressor heating mode, current has exceeded allowable limit at the operating conditions.
likelyCauses: At high speed operation (3600 RPM and above) Drive output current limit has been exceeded. Check for low indoor airflow, high system charge.
checks: On occurrence: Shutdown. Soft lockout. Send "Wait" to thermostat, send Alert to CDA home screen menu and history On clearance: Resume normal operation after compressor cutout time has elapsed. CO=5 minutes
faultCodes.notes: Display Assembly (CDA) text: 'DIAGCUR CO'. Thermostat shows: "Wait". Severity taken from System Alert Guide ERR.184.06 (Normal).
faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.26 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Protection Algorithm Fault: Maximum number of protection shutdowns (Err 184.xx) have occurred.
likelyCauses: Check previous history for 184.xx faults leading to lockout.
checks: On occurrence: Can’t start system without Service being called. Send error to thermostat and alert menu in CDA On clearance: Can be cleared only on power cycle. After power cycle, the compressor shall resume normal operation.

faultCodes.source: Trane Service Facts 4T-V0-SF-1A (4TTV0 XV20i variable-speed AC), Variable Speed Alert Codes pp.19-30, p.26 (same numbering in 4T-V0-SF-1Q and American Standard 4A6V8 AccuLink Service Facts)

faultCodes.meaning: Protection Algorithm Fault: Universal Hard Lockout. Outdoor EEV will drive open.
likelyCauses: Occurs anytime the system enters the Hard Lockout State. Investigate Alerts leading to this condition.

diagnosticTips: Architecture: the AOC (outdoor control) talks Modbus to the inverter drive (MOC/IVSC), which runs the variable-speed compressor; the outdoor EEV uses the dome (discharge) and suction sensors. A dome or suction sensor fault in heating gives limp-along at 2400 RPM (67.05/67.07).

Low pressure (79): LPCO opens at 35 psi / closes at 55 psi in heating; opens at 50 / closes at 70 psi in cooling. 79.00 = 5 min soft lockout; 79.01 = switch not reset within the soft lockout; 79.02 = hard lockout after multiple trips. Check charge, restrictions, indoor airflow (cooling) or outdoor airflow (heating), LPCO wiring.

High pressure (80): HPCO opens at 650 psig, closes below 500 psig. 80.00 = 5 min soft lockout, capacity reduced by 1/5 each time; 6 short lockouts = 80.01 hard lockout (cycle power). Reduced capacity recovers after each 2 h runtime window without a trip (80.02).

Universal hard lockout 184.08 follows any hard lockout and drives the outdoor EEV open: find the alert that led to it. Clear by cycling outdoor power or clearing fault history in the outdoor CDA (Display Assembly).

Drive comm 176.00: power-cycle the outdoor unit and check for solid earth ground (EMI), check the AOC to drive harness (multi-board units), reprogram AOC and MOC to the latest software, then call for drive authorization if it continues.

Drive overcurrent 177.04 = 5 hardware overcurrents (177.03) or 15 software overcurrents (177.02) in 1 h: run drive diagnostics and follow the Compressor Verification flow chart (compressor internal short, short to ground, burnt harness at the terminal header).
Inverter temperature 179.03-179.05: check thermal grease and cold-plate torque. Before replacing a drive, call tech support and record the failure mode (needed for the warranty claim).
Ground fault 88.01: more than 10 A sum to ground from the drive output; run the Drive Test (187.01). 187.00 / 187.01 are service modes (Evacuation, Drive Test), not faults.

90.02 SYS COM BUSY: R and B to the thermostat reversed. 106.01 Load Shed: external shutdown input T3-T4 open while configured Active. 156.01 low charge: superheat 35 F or more for more than 60 min (superheat target 10 +/- 4 F).

Charging Link VS units: subcooling charging in the 'Charging Mode-Cooling' test (UX360 or Technician Mobile App) is the only approved method, between 55 and 120 F outdoor (ODR-SVN006B-EN). Below 85 F ambient wait 3 h after power-up before starting (crankcase warm-up).
Drive replacement: ODR-SVN009B-EN (integrated variable/multi-speed control drive replacement).

diagnosticTips: L6F shows the last six faults; hold the Option button 5 s to clear the history. Menu + Option held 15 s = FD (restore factory defaults).
Gas pressure (2.1 flow chart): manifold about 1.7 in. WC natural gas / about 6.0 in. WC LP at 1st stage; maximum inlet 13.8 in. WC. On LP check the orifice (size 56).
Flame current: normal 0.75-3 uA DC; below 0.5 uA = code 8 (low flame) and ignition failures. Clean the sensor and check the ground.
Retry vs recycle: 2.1 = 3 failed ignitions in one call (flame never sensed), 1 h lockout; 2.2 = 10 recycles (flame sensed then lost), 1 h lockout.
Pressure switches: 24 V across the switch = open, 0 V = closed. Code 9 = condensate pressure switch or inducer limit: check the drain/trap and venting.
Limits: main, reverse-flow and rollout limits share code 04 on the S9V2 (the S8V2 splits them into E4.1 / E4.2); rollout is manual reset.
With zoning or a variable-speed outdoor unit, set airflow to 400 CFM/ton.
Silicon nitride igniter: 11-18 ohms cold (kit instructions 18-CH111D1-1A-EN).

controls.name: Trane Tracer CH530 (EasyView/DynaView) chiller controls - RTAC air-cooled helical rotary ('HO' design sequence)
controls.description: CH530 diagnostics for RTAC air-cooled helical-rotary chillers (owner manual RLC-SVU01B-E4, 01/2004). DynaView/EasyView show the diagnostic name; TechView also shows the 3-digit hex code (in notes; search the hex code to find it). Typos and copy errors in the manual's table (e.g. hex BE/BF 'High Oil Temperature - Compressor 2A/2B' with HPC criteria) are kept as printed. All 232 rows of the manual's diagnostic table(s) are included (rows that repeat a diagnostic name are merged into one entry; the other row is kept in its notes). Each entry: code = diagnostic name as displayed; meaning = the manual's criteria text (verbatim); notes = affects target, severity, persistence, active modes and reset level as printed. Severity mapping used here: Immediate/Normal shutdown + Latch = lockout, Immediate/Normal + NonLatch = shutdown, Special Action/Mode or Warning = warning, Info = info. Latch = manual reset required; NonLatch = clears when the condition returns to normal. Reset level Local = only a local reset (front panel / Tracer TU) clears it; Remote = local or remote (BAS) reset. Approximate legacy classes: Latch + chiller target ~ MMR, NonLatch + chiller ~ MAR, Latch + circuit ~ CMR, NonLatch + circuit ~ CAR, Warning/Info ~ IFW (interpretation, not a Trane table).
appliesTo: RTAC air-cooled helical rotary chillers with CH530 (EasyView/DynaView)

The chiller follows the value of the Tracer Default Run Command which can be previously written by Tracer and stored nonvolatilely by the MP (either use local or shutdown)

faultCodes.meaning: The compressor had previously established currents while running and then all 3 phases of current were lost. Design: Less than 10% RLA, trip in 2.64 seconds. This diagnostic will preclude the Phase Loss Diagnostic and the Transition Complete Input Opened Diagnostic from being called out. To prevent this diagnostic from occurring with the intended disconnect of main power, the minimum time to trip must be greater than the guaranteed reset time of the Starter module. Note: This diagnostic prevents nuisance latching diagnostics due to a momentary power loss. It does not protect motor/compressor from uncontrolled power reapplication. See Momentary Power Loss Diagnostic for this protection. This diagnostic is not active during the start mode before the transition complete input is proven. Thus a random power loss during a start would result in either a "Starter Fault Type 3" or a "Starter Did Not Transition" latching diagnostic.

faultCodes.meaning: Detected compressor currents greater than 10% RLA on any or all phases when the compressor was commanded off. Detection time shall be 5 second minimum and 10 seconds maximum. On detection and until the controller is manually reset: generate diagnostic, energize the appropriate alarm relay, continue to energize the Evaporator Pump Output, continue to command the affected compressor off, fully unload the effected compressor and command a normal stop to all other compressors. For as long as current continues, perform liquid level and fan control on the circuit effected.

diagnosticTips: Before resetting, download active and historic diagnostics (with time stamps) with Tracer TU (BAS-SVU047B-EN) or from the display.

Latch diagnostics need a manual reset; NonLatch diagnostics clear when the condition clears. Reset Level is the lowest level of reset that clears it: 'Remote' can be cleared by a BAS or a local reset, 'Local' only at the chiller.
'x' / 'xA' in a diagnostic name stands for the circuit / compressor (1A, 1B, 2A, 2B).
CH530/CH531 DynaView controls can be upgraded with the CDUB Symbio 800 kit (SO-SVN037B-EN).
UC800/AdaptiView-era RTAC diagnostics were not found in a public manual; this CH530 list is from 2004.

controls.name: Trane Tracer CH530 (DynaView) chiller controls - RTWD/RTUD 060-250 t water-cooled / condenserless helical rotary
controls.description: CH530 diagnostics for RTWD water-cooled and RTUD condenserless Series R chillers 060-250 t (user guide RLC-SVU05A-E4, 11/2009). Later RTWD units with UC800/Symbio controls use platform trane_rtwd_series_r_uc800. All 193 rows of the manual's diagnostic table(s) are included. Each entry: code = diagnostic name as displayed; meaning = the manual's criteria text (verbatim); notes = affects target, severity, persistence, active modes and reset level as printed. Severity mapping used here: Immediate/Normal shutdown + Latch = lockout, Immediate/Normal + NonLatch = shutdown, Special Action/Mode or Warning = warning, Info = info. Latch = manual reset required; NonLatch = clears when the condition returns to normal. Reset level Local = only a local reset (front panel / Tracer TU) clears it; Remote = local or remote (BAS) reset. Approximate legacy classes: Latch + chiller target ~ MMR, NonLatch + chiller ~ MAR, Latch + circuit ~ CMR, NonLatch + circuit ~ CAR, Warning/Info ~ IFW (interpretation, not a Trane table).

faultCodes.meaning: The compressor had previously established currents while running and then all threephases of current were lost. Design: Less than 10% RLA, trip in 2.64 seconds. This diagnostic will preclude the Phase Loss Diagnostic and the Transition Complete Input Opened Diagnostic from being called out. To prevent this diagnostic from occurring with the intended disconnect of main power, the minimum time to trip must be greater than the guaranteed reset time of the Starter module. Note: This diagnostic prevents nuisance latching diagnostics due to a momentary power loss - It does not protect motor/compressor from uncontrolled power reapplication. See Momentary Power Loss Diagnostic for this protection. This diagnostic is not active during the start mode before the transition complete input is proven. Thus a random power loss during a start would result in either a "Starter Fault Type 3" or a "Starter Did Not Transition" latching diagnostic.

faultCodes.meaning: The inferred Saturated Evap Refrigerant Temperature (calculated from suction pressure transducer dropped below the Low Refrigerant Temperature Cutout Setpoint for 1125°F-sec (25°F-sec max rate) while the circuit was running. The minimum LRTC setpoint is -5°F (18.7 Psia) the point at which oil separates from the refrigerant. During the time that the trip integral is non zero, the unload solenoid(s) of the running compressors on the circuit, shall be energized continuously and the load solenoid shall be off. Normal load/unload operation will be resumed if the trip integral decays to zero by temps above the cutout setpoint. The integral is held nonvolatily though power down, is continuously calculated, and can decay during the circuit's off cycle as conditions warrant.

faultCodes.code: Low Evaporator Leaving Water Temp: Unit Off
faultCodes.meaning: The leaving Evaporator water temp. fell below the leaving water temp cutout setting for 30 degree F seconds while the Chiller is in the Stop mode, or in Auto mode with no compressors running. Energize small Evap Circulating Pump (RTUD A/C) and Evap Water pump Relay (but only if "Evap Water Pump Diagnostic Override" setting is enabled) until diagnostic auto resets, then de-energize the circ pump and return to normal evap pump control. Automatic reset occurs when the temp rises 2°F (1.1°C) above the cutout setting for 30 minutes. This diagnostic even while active, does not prevent operation of either circuit

Automatic reset occurs when the derived evap sat temp rises 2°F (1.1°C) above the cutout setting for 1 minute or the liquid level is below -36.0 mm for 20 minutes, or any compressor restarts. OA temp is substituted for evap sat temp in case of invalidity. This diagnostic even while active, does not prevent operation of either circuit.

faultCodes.meaning: The evaporator refrigerant pressure of either circuit has risen above 190 psig. The evaporator water pump relay will be de-energized to stop the pump regardless of why the pump is running. The diagnostic will auto reset and the pump will return to normal control when all of the evaporator pressures fall below 185 psig. The primary purpose is to stop the evaporator water pump and its associated pump heat from causing refrigerant side pressures, close to the evaporator relief valve setting, when the chiller is not running, such as could occur with Evap Water Flow Overdue or Evaporator Water Flow Loss Diagnostics.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Immediate. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: All. Reset level: Remote.
faultCodes.source: Tracer CH530 Control System for Chillers RTWD/RTUD 060-250, User Guide (RLC-SVU05A-E4), diagnostics table p.41

faultCodes.meaning: The leaving water temperature exceeded the high evap water temp limit (TV service menu settable -default 105F) for 15 continuous seconds. The evaporator water pump relay will be de-energized to stop the pump but only if it is running due one of the diagnostics listed on the left . The diagnostic will auto reset and the pump will return to normal control when the temperature falls 5°F below the trip setting. The primary purpose is to stop the evaporator water pump and its associated pump heat from causing excessive waterside temperatures and waterside pressures when the chiller is not running but the evap pump is on due to either Evap Water Flow Overdue, Evaporator Water Flow Loss , or Low Evap Temp - Unit Off Diagnostics. This diagnostic will not auto clear solely due to the clearing of the enabling diagnostic.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Info and Special Action. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: Only effective if either 1)Evap Wtr Flow Overdue, 2)Evap Wtr Flow Loss, or 3)Low Evap Rfgt Temp,-Unit Off, diagnostic is active.. Reset level: Remote.
faultCodes.source: Tracer CH530 Control System for Chillers RTWD/RTUD 060-250, User Guide (RLC-SVU05A-E4), diagnostics table p.41

faultCodes.meaning: The condenser water flow proof input was open for more than 6 contiguous seconds (or 15 seconds for thermal dispersion type flow switch) after flow had been proven. This diagnostic is automatically cleared once the compressor is stopped by a fixed time out of 7 sec. In Cooling Mode: The Cond Pump shall be commanded off but the Evap pump command will not be effected. - once the diagnostic auto clears, if diff to start is met, the cond pump can be restarted. In Heating Mode: The Cond Pump shall remain on, and the Evap pump shall shut off - once diagnostic auto clears, if diff to start is met, the chiller may restart normally and the evap pump can be restarted.

diagnosticTips: Before resetting, download active and historic diagnostics (with time stamps) with Tracer TU (BAS-SVU047B-EN) or from the display.

Latch diagnostics need a manual reset; NonLatch diagnostics clear when the condition clears. Reset Level is the lowest level of reset that clears it: 'Remote' can be cleared by a BAS or a local reset, 'Local' only at the chiller.
'x' / 'xA' in a diagnostic name stands for the circuit / compressor (1A, 1B, 2A, 2B).
CH530/CH531 DynaView controls can be upgraded with the CDUB Symbio 800 kit (SO-SVN037B-EN).

controls.name: Trane Tracer CH530 chiller controls - CGAN/CXAN 209-214 and CGCL 200-600 scroll chillers
controls.description: CH530 diagnostics for the legacy CGAN/CXAN (air-cooled scroll chiller / heat pump) and CGCL scroll chillers (owner manual CG-SVU02D-E4, 01/2007). All 19 rows of the manual's diagnostic table(s) are included. Each entry: code = diagnostic name as displayed; meaning = the manual's criteria text (verbatim); notes = affects target, severity, persistence, active modes and reset level as printed. Severity mapping used here: Immediate/Normal shutdown + Latch = lockout, Immediate/Normal + NonLatch = shutdown, Special Action/Mode or Warning = warning, Info = info. Latch = manual reset required; NonLatch = clears when the condition returns to normal. Reset level Local = only a local reset (front panel / Tracer TU) clears it; Remote = local or remote (BAS) reset. Approximate legacy classes: Latch + chiller target ~ MMR, NonLatch + chiller ~ MAR, Latch + circuit ~ CMR, NonLatch + circuit ~ CAR, Warning/Info ~ IFW (interpretation, not a Trane table).

diagnosticTips: Before resetting, download active and historic diagnostics (with time stamps) with Tracer TU (BAS-SVU047B-EN) or from the display.

Latch diagnostics need a manual reset; NonLatch diagnostics clear when the condition clears. Reset Level is the lowest level of reset that clears it: 'Remote' can be cleared by a BAS or a local reset, 'Local' only at the chiller.
'x' / 'xA' in a diagnostic name stands for the circuit / compressor (1A, 1B, 2A, 2B).

controls.name: Trane Series R RTWD 60-250 t (UC800/Symbio 800 controls, TD-7 / Tracer TU) diagnostics
controls.description: Diagnostics for current Series R RTWD water-cooled helical-rotary chillers 60-250 t with UC800 / Symbio 800 controls (IOM RLC-SVX09T-EN, 10/2025; model digit 28 = 2 Symbio 800/TD-7). All 138 rows of the manual's diagnostic table(s) are included. Each entry: code = diagnostic name as displayed; meaning = the manual's criteria text (verbatim); notes = affects target, severity, persistence, active modes and reset level as printed. Severity mapping used here: Immediate/Normal shutdown + Latch = lockout, Immediate/Normal + NonLatch = shutdown, Special Action/Mode or Warning = warning, Info = info. Latch = manual reset required; NonLatch = clears when the condition returns to normal. Reset level Local = only a local reset (front panel / Tracer TU) clears it; Remote = local or remote (BAS) reset. Approximate legacy classes: Latch + chiller target ~ MMR, NonLatch + chiller ~ MAR, Latch + circuit ~ CMR, NonLatch + circuit ~ CAR, Warning/Info ~ IFW (interpretation, not a Trane table).

faultCodes.code: Compressor Did Not Accelerate: Shutdown - xy

faultCodes.meaning: a) No current was sensed on one or two of the current transformer inputs while running or starting (See Non- latching Power Loss Diagnostic for all three phases lost while running). Must hold = 20% RLA. Must trip = 5% RLA. Time to trip shall be longer than guaranteed reset on Starter Module at a minimum, 3 seconds maximum. Actual design trip point is 10%. The actual design trip time is 2.64 seconds. b) If Phase reversal protection is enabled and current is not sensed on one or more current transformer inputs. Logic will detect and trip in a maximum of 0.3 seconds from compressor start.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Cprsr. Severity: Immediate. Persistence: Latch. Active modes [inactive]: Start Sequence and Run modes. Reset level: Local. Table: Starter diagnostics.

faultCodes.meaning: The compressor had previously established currents while running and then all three phases of current were lost. Design: Less than 10% RLA, trip in 2.64 seconds. This diagnostic will preclude the Phase Loss Diagnostic and the Transition Complete Input Opened Diagnostic from being called out. To prevent this diagnostic from occurring with the intended disconnect of main power, the minimum time to trip must be greater than the guaranteed reset time of the Starter module. Note: This diagnostic prevents nuisance latching diagnostics due to a momentary power loss – It does not protect motor/compressor from uncontrolled power reapplication. See Momentary Power Loss Diagnostic for this protection. This diagnostic is not active during the start mode before the transition complete input is proven. Thus a random power loss during a start would result in either a “Starter Fault Type 3” or a “Starter Did Not Transition” latching diagnostic.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Cprsr. Severity: Immediate. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: All compressor running modes [all compressor starting and non- running modes]. Reset level: Remote. Table: Starter diagnostics.

For as long as current continues, keep both the Evap and Cond pumps in an override-on mode, perform liquid level, oil return, and condenser head pressure control on the circuit effected.

The diagnostic is auto cleared when both the saturated temperature is 2ºF (1.1ºC) above the Condenser Freeze Avoidance Setpoint for 1 minute and the anti short cycling count down calculation reaches 0(see Low Rfgt Condenser Temperature Protection spec), or with the start of either circuit. This diagnostic even while active, does not prevent operation of either circuit.

faultCodes.meaning: The Condenser water flow proof input was open for more than 6 contiguous seconds after flow had been proven. In Normal Cooling or Ice Building Mode, the Cond Pump is commanded off and this diagnostic is automatically cleared once the compressor is stopped by a fixed time out of 7 seconds. This diagnostic may stop the Evaporator Pump pursuant to other possible diagnostic overrides. In the Heating Mode, this diagnostic does not affect the Cond Pump output and 6 seconds of flow will auto-reset the diagnostic.

In the case where the pump is overridden to “On” per certain freeze avoidance diagnostics, the delay on the callout of this diagnostic will be shortened to 255 seconds. In Cooling and Ice Building Modes the pump command status will not be affected by this diagnostic and it will generally remain on. In the Heating Mode of Operation, this diagnostic will generally force the pump to be off, excepting certain freeze avoidance diagnostic overrides.

faultCodes.code: High Compressor Refrigerant Discharge Temp - xy
faultCodes.meaning: The compressor discharge temperature exceeded 199.4ºF (without oil cooler) or 230ºF (with oil cooler). This diagnostic will be suppressed during Stopping mode or after the compressor has stopped. Note: As part of the Compressor High Temperature Limit Mode (aka Minimum Capacity Limit), the compressor shall be forced loaded as the filtered discharge temperature reaches 190ºF (without oil coolers), or 220ºF (with oil coolers).
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Cprsr. Severity: Immediate. Persistence: Latch. Active modes [inactive]: All [compressor run unload or compressor not running]. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.

faultCodes.meaning: The evaporator saturated temperature (circuit1 or circuit2) has risen above 76F (24.4°C) for R513A or 82ºF (27.8°C) for R1234ze(E)/R515B for more than 5 minutes. The diagnostic will auto reset when all of the evaporator saturated temperatures fall below limit temperature minus 0.5K. The ignore time (default 5 minutes) is configurable with level4 parameter Suction Pressure Tracking Time. If it is set to zero, the diagnostic is disabled.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Immediate. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: Any Ckt Energized [Stop]. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Series R Rotary Liquid Chillers Water-Cooled Model RTWD 60 to 250 Tons (RLC-SVX09T-EN), diagnostics table p.79

faultCodes.meaning: Either the leaving or the entering water temperature exceeded the high evap water temp limit (TU service menu settable –default 105°F (65.55°C), range 80°F (26.67°C)- 150°F(65.55°C) for 15 continuous seconds. The evaporator water pump relay will be de-energized to stop the pump but only if it is running due one of the diagnostics listed on the left. The diagnostic will auto reset and the pump will return to normal control when both the entering and leaving temperatures fall 5°F below the trip setting. The primary purpose is to stop the evaporator water pump and its associated pump heat from causing excessive waterside temperatures and waterside pressures when the chiller is not running but the evap pump is on due to either Evap Water Flow Overdue, Evaporator Water Flow Loss , or Low Evap Temp – Unit Off Diagnostics. This diagnostic will not auto clear solely due to the clearing of the enabling diagnostic.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Warning and Special Action. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: Only effective if either 1) Evap Wtr Flow Overdue, 2) Evap Wtr Flow Loss, or 3) Low Evap Rfgt Temp,-Unit Off, diagnostic is active.. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Series R Rotary Liquid Chillers Water-Cooled Model RTWD 60 to 250 Tons (RLC-SVX09T-EN), diagnostics table p.80

This pressure ratio is a fundamental limitation of the particular compressor design. The pressure ratio is defined as Pcond (abs)/Pevap(abs) Low Vi GP2 Cprsr: 5.61.

faultCodes.meaning: The entering evaporator water temp fell below the leaving evaporator water temp by more than 2°F for 180 °F-sec, minimum trip time 30 seconds. Diagnostic will auto clear if the leaving water temp – entering water temp < 2°F. It can warn of improper flow direction through the evaporator, misbound water temperature sensors, improper sensor installation, grossly inaccurate sensors, or other system problems. Note that either entering or leaving water temp sensor or the water system could be at fault.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Warning/Normal. Persistence: NonLatch/Latch. Active modes [inactive]: Any Ckt Energized [No Ckts Energized]. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.

faultCodes.meaning: Oil Loss Level Sensor detects a lack of oil in the oil sump feeding the compressor for 90 seconds after EXV preposition is completed (and before EXV equalization, if applicable) on an attempted circuit start. Note: Compressor start is delayed pending oil detection during that time, but not allowed once the diagnostic occurs.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Circuit. Severity: Immediate and Special Action. Persistence: Latch. Active modes [inactive]: Compressor Pre- Start [all other modes]. Reset level: Local. Table: Main processor diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Series R Rotary Liquid Chillers Water-Cooled Model RTWD 60 to 250 Tons (RLC-SVX09T-EN), diagnostics table p.81

faultCodes.code: Low Condenser Rfgt Temp Circuit 1: Unit Off
faultCodes.meaning: This diagnostic is based on dew point from condenser refrigerant pressure transducer of circuit 1 falling below the Condenser Freeze Avoidance Setpoint. When this diagnostic is active, both the Condenser Water Freeze Avoidance Request Relay is turned on and the Condenser Water Pump request is placed in a “Diagnostic Override mode” and forced on regardless of the chiller mode. The diagnostic is auto cleared when both the saturated temperature is 2°F (1.1°C) above the Condenser Freeze Avoidance Setpoint for 1 minute and the anti short cycling count down calculation reaches 0 (see Low Rfgt Condenser Temperature Protection spec), or with the start of either circuit. This diagnostic even while active, does not prevent operation of either circuit.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Special Action. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: Unit in Stop Mode, or in Auto Mode and No Ckt(s) Energized [Any Ckt Energized]. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Series R Rotary Liquid Chillers Water-Cooled Model RTWD 60 to 250 Tons (RLC-SVX09T-EN), diagnostics table p.81

faultCodes.meaning: For start-up, please refer to oil flow protection spec. For running, the system differential pressure for the respective circuit was below the greater of 25 psid (240.5 kPa) or the pressure ratio listed in the table in GP2 Compressor Type FSpec while the compressor is running for a period of time dependent on the deficit (15 seconds ignore time from circuit start) – refer to the Oil Flow Protection specification for the time to trip function.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Cprsr. Severity: Immediate. Persistence: Latch. Active modes [inactive]: Cprsr Energized. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.

faultCodes.meaning: While Running Normally, the Compressor Discharge Superheat was less than the Low Discharge Superheat Setpoint (default 10°F) for more than 6500 degree F seconds. At circuit start-up, the Discharge Superheat will be ignored for 5 minutes.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Cprsr. Severity: Normal. Persistence: Latch. Active modes [inactive]: Any Running Mode. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Series R Rotary Liquid Chillers Water-Cooled Model RTWD 60 to 250 Tons (RLC-SVX09T-EN), diagnostics table p.81

faultCodes.meaning: a. The Evaporator Pressure (as measured by the cprsr(s) suction pressure transducers) for the respective circuit, dropped below 10 Psia just prior to the circuit’s 1st compressor start (after EXV preposition). b. During Early Start-up Period: the Evaporator Pressure fell 10 psia. c. After Early Start-up Period expires: The Evaporator Pressure fell below 16 Psia. (Note: the Early Start-up Period is fixed at 3 minutes relative to the start of the 1st cprsr of the ckt. If ckt is manifolded, the Evap pressure is defined by the lower of the two manifolded compressor suction pressures.)
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Circuit. Severity: Immediate. Persistence: Latch. Active modes [inactive]: Cprsr Prestart and Cprsr Energized. Reset level: Local. Table: Main processor diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Series R Rotary Liquid Chillers Water-Cooled Model RTWD 60 to 250 Tons (RLC-SVX09T-EN), diagnostics table p.82

faultCodes.meaning: The warmer of either the either the Evaporator Refrigerant Pool Temperature or Active Rfgt Sat Temp for the respective circuit dropped below the Low Refrigerant Temperature Cutout Setpoint for 1125ºF-sec (12ºF-sec max rate for early circuit start-up period) while the circuit was running. The minimum LRTC setpoint is -5ºF the point at which oil separates from the refrigerant. The integral is held nonvolatile though power down, is continuously calculated, and can decay or build during the circuit off cycle as conditions warrant.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Circuit. Severity: Immediate. Persistence: Latch. Active modes [inactive]: All Ckt Running Modes. Reset level: Local. Table: Main processor diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Series R Rotary Liquid Chillers Water-Cooled Model RTWD 60 to 250 Tons (RLC-SVX09T-EN), diagnostics table p.82

faultCodes.code: Low Evaporator Refrigerant Temperature Circuit 1: Unit Off
faultCodes.meaning: The respective circuit’s LERTC Integral was seen to be > 0 while the chiller is in the Stop mode, or in Auto mode with no compressors running for at least one minute. The LERTC integral is increased if the Evap Refrigerant Pool Temp is below the value of the Low Evap Rfgt Temp Cutout + 2°F. Energize Evap Water Pump and Off-Cycle Freeze Avoidance Request Relay until diagnostic auto resets, then return to normal evap pump control and de-energize the Freeze Avoidance Request. Automatic reset occurs when the respective Evap Rfgt Pool Temp rises 4°F(1.1°C) above the LERTC cutout setting for 1 minute and the Chiller Off LERTC Integral = 0.. This diagnostic even while active, does not prevent operation of either circuit.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Special Action. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: Unit in Stop Mode, or in Auto Mode and No Ckt(s) Energized [Any Ckt Energized]. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Series R Rotary Liquid Chillers Water-Cooled Model RTWD 60 to 250 Tons (RLC-SVX09T-EN), diagnostics table p.82

faultCodes.code: Low Evaporator Refrigerant Temperature Circuit 2: Unit Off
faultCodes.meaning: The respective circuit’s LERTC Integral was seen to be > 0 while the chiller is in the Stop mode, or in Auto mode with no compressors running for at least one minute. The LERTC integral is increased if the Evap Refrigerant Pool Temp is below the value of the Low Evap Rfgt Temp Cutout + 2°F. Energize Evap Water Pump and Off-Cycle Freeze Avoidance Request Relay until diagnostic auto resets, then return to normal evap pump control and de-energize the Freeze Avoidance Request. Automatic reset occurs when the respective Evap Rfgt Pool Temp rises 4°F(1.1°C) above the LERTC cutout setting for 1 minute and the Chiller Off LERTC Integral = 0.. This diagnostic even while active, does not prevent operation of either circuit.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Special Action. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: Unit in Stop Mode, or in Auto Mode and No Ckt(s) Energized [Any Ckt Energized]. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Series R Rotary Liquid Chillers Water-Cooled Model RTWD 60 to 250 Tons (RLC-SVX09T-EN), diagnostics table p.83

faultCodes.meaning: Either the entering or leaving evaporator water temp fell below the leaving water temp cutout setting for 30 degree F-seconds while the Chiller is in the Stop mode, or in Auto mode with no compressors running. Energize Freeze Avoidance Request Relay and Evap Water Pump Relay until diagnostic auto resets, then de-energize the Freeze Avoidance Request Relay and return to normal evap pump control. Automatic reset occurs when both temps rise 2°F (1.1°C) above the cutout setting for 5 minutes, or either circuit starts. This diagnostic even while active, does not prevent operation of either circuit.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Special Action. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: Unit in Stop Mode, or in Auto Mode and No Ckt(s) Energized [Any Ckt Energized]. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Series R Rotary Liquid Chillers Water-Cooled Model RTWD 60 to 250 Tons (RLC-SVX09T-EN), diagnostics table p.83

faultCodes.meaning: The evaporator entering or leaving water temperature fell below the cutout setpoint for 30 degree F Seconds while the compressor was running. Automatic reset occurs when both of the temperature rises 2°F(1.1°C) above the cutout setting for 2 minutes. This diagnostic shall not de-energize the Evaporator Water Pump Output.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Immediate and Special Action. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: Any Ckt[s] Energized [No Ckt(s) Energized]. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Series R Rotary Liquid Chillers Water-Cooled Model RTWD 60 to 250 Tons (RLC-SVX09T-EN), diagnostics table p.83

faultCodes.meaning: The intermediate oil pressure sensor for this compressor was out of the acceptable pressure range for 15 seconds, while the Delta Pressure was greater than 15 Psid (172.4 kPa).: Acceptable range is 0.50 > (PC-PI) / (PC-PE) for the first 2.5 minutes of operation, and 0.28 > (PC-PI) / (PC-PE) thereafter.

The events that led up to this failure, if known, should be recorded and transmitted to Trane Controls Engineering.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Immediate. Persistence: Latch. Active modes [inactive]: All. Reset level: Local. Table: Main processor diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Series R Rotary Liquid Chillers Water-Cooled Model RTWD 60 to 250 Tons (RLC-SVX09T-EN), diagnostics table p.84

faultCodes.meaning: The main processor has successfully come out of a reset and built its application. A reset may have been due to a power up, installing new software or configuration. diagnosticTips: Before resetting, download active and historic diagnostics (with time stamps) with Tracer TU (BAS-SVU047B-EN) or from the display.

Latch diagnostics need a manual reset; NonLatch diagnostics clear when the condition clears. Reset Level is the lowest level of reset that clears it: 'Remote' can be cleared by a BAS or a local reset, 'Local' only at the chiller.
'x' / 'xA' in a diagnostic name stands for the circuit / compressor (1A, 1B, 2A, 2B).

controls.name: Trane Series R RTHD water-cooled helical rotary with Symbio 800 diagnostics
controls.description: Diagnostics for Series R RTHD water-cooled helical-rotary chillers with Symbio 800 controls (IOM RTHD-SVX01P-EN, 07/2026), including starter, local communication drive (AFD), main processor and communication diagnostics. All 137 rows of the manual's diagnostic table(s) are included (rows that repeat a diagnostic name are merged into one entry; the other row is kept in its notes). Each entry: code = diagnostic name as displayed; meaning = the manual's criteria text (verbatim); notes = affects target, severity, persistence, active modes and reset level as printed. Severity mapping used here: Immediate/Normal shutdown + Latch = lockout, Immediate/Normal + NonLatch = shutdown, Special Action/Mode or Warning = warning, Info = info. Latch = manual reset required; NonLatch = clears when the condition returns to normal. Reset level Local = only a local reset (front panel / Tracer TU) clears it; Remote = local or remote (BAS) reset. Approximate legacy classes: Latch + chiller target ~ MMR, NonLatch + chiller ~ MAR, Latch + circuit ~ CMR, NonLatch + circuit ~ CAR, Warning/Info ~ IFW (interpretation, not a Trane table).

faultCodes.meaning: a) No current was sensed on one or two of the current transformer inputs while running or starting (See Nonlatching Power Loss Diagnostic for all three phases lost while running). Must hold = 20% RLA. Must trip = 5% RLA. Time to trip shall be longer than guaranteed reset on Starter Module at a minimum, 3 seconds maximum. Actual design trip point is 10%. The actual design trip time is 2.64 seconds. b) If Phase reversal protection is enabled and current is not sensed on one or more current transformer inputs. Logic will detect and trip in a maximum of 0.3 second from compressor start.

faultCodes.meaning: The compressor had previously established currents while running and then all three phases of current were lost. Design: Less than 10% RLA, trip in 2.64 seconds. This diagnostic will preclude the Phase Loss Diagnostic and the Transition Complete Input Opened Diagnostic from being called out. To prevent this diagnostic from occurring with the intended disconnect of main power, the minimum time to trip must be greater than the guaranteed reset time of the Starter module. Note: This diagnostic prevents nuisance latching diagnostics due to a momentary power loss – It does not protect motor/compressor from uncontrolled power reapplication. See Momentary Power Loss Diagnostic for this protection. This diagnostic will auto reset in 10 seconds from its occurrence and is not active during the start mode before the transition complete input is proven. This prevents the chiller from cycling due to some internal starter problem, as the starter would latch out on either a “Starter Fault Type 3” or a “Starter Did Not Transition” latching diagnostic. However true power loss occurring during a start would result in a misdiagnosis and the chiller would not automatically recover.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Immediate. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: All compressor running modes [all compressor starting and non-running modes]. Reset level: Remote. Table: Starter diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Series R Water-Cooled Chillers with Symbio 800 controls Model RTHD (RTHD-SVX01P-EN), diagnostics table p.75

faultCodes.meaning: The evaporator refrigerant pressure has risen above 190 psig. The evaporator water pump relay will be de-energized to stop the pump regardless of why the pump is running. The diagnostic will auto reset and the pump will return to normal control when the evaporator pressures falls below 185 psig. This diagnostic must shutdown the chiller if it is running.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Immediate and Special Action. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: All. Reset level: Local. Table: Main processor diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Series R Water-Cooled Chillers with Symbio 800 controls Model RTHD (RTHD-SVX01P-EN), diagnostics table p.79

faultCodes.meaning: The leaving water temperature exceeded the high evap water temp limit for 15 continuous seconds. The evaporator water pump relay will be de-energized to stop the pump but only if it is running due one of the diagnostics listed on the right. The diagnostic will auto reset and the pump will return to normal control when the temperature falls 5°F below the trip setting. The primary purpose is to stop the evaporator water pump and its associated pump heat from causing excessive waterside temperatures and waterside pressures when the chiller is not running but the evap pump is on due to either Evap Water Flow Overdue, Evaporator Water Flow Loss , or Low Evap Temp – Unit Off Diagnostics. This diagnostic will not auto clear solely due to the clearing of the enabling diagnostic.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Warning and Special Action. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: Only effective if either 1)Evap Wtr Flow Overdue, 2) Evap Wtr Flow Loss, or 3)Low Evap Rfgt Temp,-Unit Off, diagnostic is active.. Reset level: Local. Table: Main processor diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Series R Water-Cooled Chillers with Symbio 800 controls Model RTHD (RTHD-SVX01P-EN), diagnostics table p.80

faultCodes.meaning: The system pressure ratio exceeded 5.61 for 1 contiguous minute. This pressure ratio is a fundamental limitation of the compressor. The pressure ratio is defined as Pcond (abs)/ Pevap(abs).
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Immediate. Persistence: Latch. Active modes [inactive]: Service Pumpdown Only. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.

Also see diagnostic below

faultCodes.meaning: a. The inferred Saturated Evap Refrigerant Temperature dropped below the Low Refrigerant Temperature Cutout Setpoint for 450°F-sec while the circuit was running after the ignore period had expired. The integral is held at zero for the 1 minute ignore time following the circuit start-up and the integral will be limited to never trip in less than 45 seconds. b. During the timeout of the trip integral, the unload solenoid (s) of the running compressors on the circuit, shall be energized continuously and the load solenoid shall be off. Normal load/unload operation will be resumed if the trip integral is reset by return to temps above the cutout setpoint.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Immediate. Persistence: Latch. Active modes [inactive]: All Ckt Running Modes. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.

Energize Evap Water pump Relay until diagnostic auto resets, then return to normal evap pump control. Automatic reset occurs when either the evap temp rises 2°F (1.1°C) above the cutout setting or the liquid level falls below -21.2mm for 30 minutes
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Warning and Special Action. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: Unit in Stop Mode, or in Auto Mode and No Ckt's Energizd [Any Ckt Energizd]. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.

faultCodes.meaning: a. The evap. water flow measurement option was installed and the flow dropped to or below the Evaporator Low Water Flow Warning Setpoint in TV. This IFW shall be Auto Reset and reset 0.1 gpm/ton above the adjustable trip point or when the Evaporator water pump is turned off. b. See Water Flow and Tons Sensing specification for additional information.

diagnosticTips: Before resetting, download active and historic diagnostics (with time stamps) with Tracer TU (BAS-SVU047B-EN) or from the display.

Latch diagnostics need a manual reset; NonLatch diagnostics clear when the condition clears. Reset Level is the lowest level of reset that clears it: 'Remote' can be cleared by a BAS or a local reset, 'Local' only at the chiller.
'x' / 'xA' in a diagnostic name stands for the circuit / compressor (1A, 1B, 2A, 2B).

controls.name: Trane Sintesis RTAF air-cooled helical rotary (AFD compressors, Symbio/UC800) diagnostics
controls.description: Diagnostics for Sintesis RTAF air-cooled helical-rotary chillers with Adaptive Frequency Drive compressors (IOM RTAF-SVX001P-EN, 04/2026): AFD, starter and main processor diagnostics. All 102 rows of the manual's diagnostic table(s) are included. Each entry: code = diagnostic name as displayed; meaning = the manual's criteria text (verbatim); notes = affects target, severity, persistence, active modes and reset level as printed. Severity mapping used here: Immediate/Normal shutdown + Latch = lockout, Immediate/Normal + NonLatch = shutdown, Special Action/Mode or Warning = warning, Info = info. Latch = manual reset required; NonLatch = clears when the condition returns to normal. Reset level Local = only a local reset (front panel / Tracer TU) clears it; Remote = local or remote (BAS) reset. Approximate legacy classes: Latch + chiller target ~ MMR, NonLatch + chiller ~ MAR, Latch + circuit ~ CMR, NonLatch + circuit ~ CAR, Warning/Info ~ IFW (interpretation, not a Trane table).

faultCodes.meaning: Respective AFD is reporting that it is still running the compressor when the MP has commanded the drive/ compressor to be Off. Detection time shall be 10 seconds minimum and 15 seconds maximum. On detection and until the controller is manually reset: this diagnostic shall be active and the alarm relay shall be energized, the Evap Pump Output will be energized, the effected compressor will be continually commanded off, and be unloaded, while a normal stop shall be commanded to all other compressors. For as long as compressor operation continues, the MP shall continue oil return and fan control on the circuit affected. During contactor interrupt failure, circuit will not be confirmed off, so THR unit sequence should continue running. If THR turns off due to a diagnostic or lockout during contactor interrupt failure, the circuit reverts to air-cooled condenser fan control within 1 second.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Immediate Shutdown and Special Action. Persistence: Latch. Active modes [inactive]: AFD Intended to be OFF. Reset level: Local. Table: AFD diagnostics.

faultCodes.meaning: a) No current was sensed on one or two of the current transformer inputs while running or starting (See Nonlatching Power Loss Diagnostic for all three phases lost while running). Must hold = 20% RLA. Must trip = 5% RLA. Time to trip shall be longer than guaranteed reset on Starter Module at a minimum, 3 seconds maximum. Actual design trip point is 10%. The actual design trip time is 2.64 seconds. b) If Phase reversal protection is enabled and current is not sensed on one or more current xformer inputs. Logic will detect and trip in a maximum of 0.3 seconds from compressor start.

faultCodes.meaning: The compressor had previously established currents while running and then all three phases of current were lost. Design: Less than 10% RLA, trip in 2.64 seconds. This diagnostic will preclude the Phase Loss Diagnostic and the Transition Complete Input Opened Diagnostic from being called out. To prevent this diagnostic from occurring with the intended disconnect of main power, the minimum time to trip must be greater than the guaranteed reset time of the Starter module. Note: This diagnostic prevents nuisance latching diagnostics due to a momentary power loss – It does not protect motor/ compressor from uncontrolled power reapplication. See Momentary Power Loss Diagnostic for this protection. This diagnostic is not active during the start mode before the transition complete input is proven. Thus a random power loss during a start would result in either a “Starter Fault Type 3” or a “Starter Did Not Transition” latching diagnostic.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Cprsr. Severity: Immediate. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: All compressor running modes [all compressor starting and non- running modes]. Reset level: Remote. Table: Starter diagnostics.

faultCodes.meaning: The evaporator refrigerant pool temperature measurement is larger than the evaporator entering water temperature by more than 4°C (7.2°F) for 5 continuous minutes. There is an ignore time of 2 minutes following circuit start-up. The trip criteria is not evaluated (and time above the threshold is not counted) until the ignore time passes. Invalidate evaporator pool temperature sensor measurement if this diagnostic is active. If evaporator isolation valves are installed, revert to Evaporator Shell Refrigerant Saturated Temperature for freeze protection functions. If evaporator isolation valves are not installed, revert to Evaporator Saturated Temperature for freeze protection functions. Pool Temp Sensor may have failed due to incorrect installation, improper insulation, or an offset pool temperature measurement typically caused by moisture intrusion.

faultCodes.meaning: The compressor discharge temperature exceeded 199.4?F (without oil cooler) or 230ºF (with oil cooler). This diagnostic will be suppressed during Stopping mode or after the compressor has stopped. Note: As part of the Compressor High Temperature Limit Mode (aka Minimum Capacity Limit), the compressor shall be forced loaded as the filtered discharge temperature reaches 190ºF (without oil coolers), or 220ºF (with oil coolers).

faultCodes.code: High Evaporator Refrigerant Pressure High Evap Rfgt Pressure
faultCodes.meaning: The evaporator refrigerant pressure of either circuit has risen above 190 psig. The evaporator water pump relay will be de-energized to stop the pump regardless of why the pump is running. The diagnostic will auto reset and the pump will return to normal control when all of the evaporator pressures fall below 185 psig. The primary purpose is to stop the evaporator water pump and its associated pump heat from causing refrigerant side pressures, close to the evaporator relief valve setting, when the chiller is not running, such as could occur with Evap Water Flow Overdue or Evaporator Water Flow Loss Diagnostics.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Immediate. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: All. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Sintesis Air-Cooled Chillers Model RTAF (RTAF-SVX001P-EN), diagnostics table p.106

faultCodes.code: High Evaporator Shell Refrigerant Pressure – Circuit 1 High Evap Shell Rfgt Pressure - Ckt1 High Evap Shell Press Ckt1
faultCodes.meaning: The evaporator shell refrigerant pressure is installed, is valid, and has risen above 190 psig. - De-energize evaporator water pump regardless of why the pump is running. - Open the circuit’s EXV to 20% to allow refrigerant flow to other parts of the chiller, if liquid line refrigerant pressure is less than 170 psig. Return EXV to normal control (allow it to close until needed for circuit operation) if liquid line refrigerant pressure is greater than 175 psig. Automatically clear diagnostic when evaporator shell refrigerant pressure is valid and drops below 180 psig. - Allow evaporator water pump to return to normal control. - Return circuit’s EXV to normal control (allow it to close until needed for circuit operation). Primary causes of this diagnostic: - Evaporator water pump heat transferred to evaporator, either by flow blockage, or by lack of heat dissipation in the water loop in the presence of flow. - Commissioning unit in high ambient temperature environments. - Water box heater thermostat failed closed.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Immediate. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: All. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Sintesis Air-Cooled Chillers Model RTAF (RTAF-SVX001P-EN), diagnostics table p.106

faultCodes.code: High Evaporator Water Temperature High Evap Water Temperature
faultCodes.meaning: Either the leaving or the entering water temperature exceeded the high evap water temp limit (TU service menu settable –default 105F(65.55C), range 80F (26.67C)- 150F(65.55C) for 15 continuous seconds. The evaporator water pump relay will be de- energized to stop the pump but only if it is running due one of the diagnostics listed on the left. The diagnostic will auto reset and the pump will return to normal control when both the entering and leaving temperatures fall 5°F below the trip setting. The primary purpose is to stop the evaporator water pump and its associated pump heat from causing excessive waterside temperatures and waterside pressures when the chiller is not running but the evap pump is on due to either Evap Water Flow Overdue, Evaporator Water Flow Loss, or Low Evap Temp – Unit Off Diagnostics. This diagnostic will not auto clear solely due to the clearing of the enabling diagnostic.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Info and Special Action. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: Only effective if either 1)Evap Wtr Flow Overdue 2)Evap Wtr Flow Loss or 3)Low Evap Rfgt Temp,- Unit Off, diagnostic is active.. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Sintesis Air-Cooled Chillers Model RTAF (RTAF-SVX001P-EN), diagnostics table p.107

faultCodes.code: Low Evaporator Rfgt Temp Circuit 1: Unit Off Low Evaporator Rfgt Temp Ckt 1: Unit Off Low Evap Rfgt Temp: Unit Off
faultCodes.meaning: The respective circuit’s LERTC Integral was seen to be > 0 while the chiller is in the Stop mode, or in Auto mode with no compressors running for at least one minute. The LERTC integral is increased if the Evap Refrigerant Pool Temp is below the value of the Low Evap Rfgt Temp Cutout + 2°F. Energize Evap Water Pump and Off-Cycle Freeze Avoidance Request Relay until diagnostic auto resets, then return to normal evap pump control and de-energize the Freeze Avoidance Request. Automatic reset occurs when the respective Evap Rfgt Pool Temp rises 4°F (1.1°C) above the LERTC cutout setting for 1 minute and the Chiller Off LERTC Integral = 0. This diagnostic even while active, does not prevent operation of either circuit.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Special Action. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: Unit in Stop Mode, or in Auto Mode and No Ckt's Energzd [Any Ckt Energzd]. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Sintesis Air-Cooled Chillers Model RTAF (RTAF-SVX001P-EN), diagnostics table p.108

The LERTC integral is increased if the Evap Refrigerant Pool Temp is below the value of the Low Evap Rfgt Temp Cutout + 2°F. Energize Evap Water Pump and Off-Cycle Freeze Avoidance Request Relay until diagnostic auto resets, then return to normal evap pump control and de-energize the Freeze Avoidance Request. faultCodes.meaning: Either the entering or leaving evaporator water temp. fell below the leaving water temp cutout setting for 30 degree F seconds while the Chiller is in the Stop mode, or in Auto mode with no compressors running. Energize Freeze Avoidance Request Relay and Evap Water Pump Relay until diagnostic auto resets, then de-energize the Freeze Avoidance Request Relay and return to normal evap pump control. Automatic reset occurs when both temps rise 2°F (1.1°C) above the cutout setting for 5 minutes, or either circuit starts. This diagnostic even while active, does not prevent operation of either circuit.

faultCodes.meaning: The respective Evaporator Refrigerant Pool Temperature dropped below the Low Refrigerant Temperature Cutout Setpoint for 2250°F-sec (12°F- sec max rate for early circuit start-up period) while the circuit was running. The minimum LRTC setpoint is -5° F (18.7 Psia) the point at which oil separates from the refrigerant. The integral is held nonvolatile though power down, is continuously calculated, and can decay or build during the circuit off cycle as conditions warrant.

diagnosticTips: Before resetting, download active and historic diagnostics (with time stamps) with Tracer TU (BAS-SVU047B-EN) or from the display.

Latch diagnostics need a manual reset; NonLatch diagnostics clear when the condition clears. Reset Level is the lowest level of reset that clears it: 'Remote' can be cleared by a BAS or a local reset, 'Local' only at the chiller.
'x' / 'xA' in a diagnostic name stands for the circuit / compressor (1A, 1B, 2A, 2B).

controls.name: Trane Series R RTZA heat pump chiller (Symbio 800) diagnostics
controls.description: Diagnostics for the Series R RTZA water-to-water heat pump chiller (IOM RLC-SVX033A-EN, 05/2026; R-1233zd(E)). All 132 rows of the manual's diagnostic table(s) are included. Each entry: code = diagnostic name as displayed; meaning = the manual's criteria text (verbatim); notes = affects target, severity, persistence, active modes and reset level as printed. Severity mapping used here: Immediate/Normal shutdown + Latch = lockout, Immediate/Normal + NonLatch = shutdown, Special Action/Mode or Warning = warning, Info = info. Latch = manual reset required; NonLatch = clears when the condition returns to normal. Reset level Local = only a local reset (front panel / Tracer TU) clears it; Remote = local or remote (BAS) reset. Approximate legacy classes: Latch + chiller target ~ MMR, NonLatch + chiller ~ MAR, Latch + circuit ~ CMR, NonLatch + circuit ~ CAR, Warning/Info ~ IFW (interpretation, not a Trane table).

faultCodes.code: Compressor Did Not Accelerate: Shutdown - xy
faultCodes.meaning: Acceleration Time Out Action set to Shutdown: Compressor motor current did not drop below 85% RLA within the Maximum Acceleration Setting setpoint. Compressor motor de-energized. See Current Overload Protection specification.

faultCodes.meaning: a) No current was sensed on one or two of the current transformer inputs while running or starting (See Non- latching Power Loss Diagnostic for all three phases lost while running). Must hold = 20% RLA. Must trip = 5% RLA. Time to trip shall be longer than guaranteed reset on Starter Module at a minimum, 3 seconds maximum. Actual design trip point is 10%. The actual design trip time is 2.64 seconds. b) If Phase reversal protection is enabled and current is not sensed on one or more current transformer inputs. Logic will detect and trip in a maximum of 0.3 seconds from compressor start.

faultCodes.meaning: The compressor had previously established currents while running and then all three phases of current were lost. Design: Less than 10% RLA, trip in 2.64 seconds. This diagnostic will preclude the Phase Loss Diagnostic and the Transition Complete Input Opened Diagnostic from being called out. To prevent this diagnostic from occurring with the intended disconnect of main power, the minimum time to trip must be greater than the guaranteed reset time of the Starter module. Note: This diagnostic prevents nuisance latching diagnostics due to a momentary power loss – It does not protect motor/compressor from uncontrolled power reapplication. See Momentary Power Loss Diagnostic for this protection. This diagnostic is not active during the start mode before the transition complete input is proven. Thus a random power loss during a start would result in either a “Starter Fault Type 3” or a “Starter Did Not Transition” latching diagnostic.
faultCodes.notes: Severity: Immediate. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: All compressor running modes [all compressor starting and non- running modes]. Reset level: Remote. Table: Starter diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Series R Heat Pump Chiller Model RTZA (RLC-SVX033A-EN), diagnostics table p.96

faultCodes.meaning: Detected compressor currents greater than 10% RLA on any or all phases when the compressor was commanded off. Detection time shall be 5 second minimum and 10 seconds maximum. faultCodes.meaning: Either the leaving or the entering water temperature exceeded the high evap water temp limit (TU service menu settable –default 145°F (62.77°C), range 80°F (26.67°C)-145°F (62.77°C) for 15 continuous seconds. The evaporator water pump relay will be de- energized to stop the pump but only if it is running due one of the diagnostics listed on the left. The diagnostic will auto reset and the pump will return to normal control when both the entering and leaving temperatures fall 5°F below the trip setting. The primary purpose is to stop the evaporator water pump and its associated pump heat from causing excessive waterside temperatures and waterside pressures when the chiller is not running but the evap pump is on due to either Evap Water Flow Overdue, Evaporator Water Flow Loss , or Low Evap Temp – Unit Off Diagnostics. This diagnostic will not auto clear solely due to the clearing of the enabling diagnostic.
faultCodes.notes: Severity: Warning and Special Action. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: Only effective if either 1) Evap Wtr Flow Overdue, 2) Evap Wtr Flow Loss, or 3) Low Evap Rfgt Temp,-Unit Off, diagnostic is active.. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Series R Heat Pump Chiller Model RTZA (RLC-SVX033A-EN), diagnostics table p.105

faultCodes.meaning: A high pressure cutout was detected. When a high pressure cutout occurs, a shunt trip circuit breaker in the low voltage control panel trips. The shunt trip circuit breaker must be manually reset to allow the compressor to start. If the shunt trip is not reset, the High Pressure Cutout alarm will re-occur after every front panel Alarm Reset.

Diagnostic will auto clear if the entering water temp – leaving water temp < 2F. It can detect improper flow direction through the condenser, misbound water temperature sensors, improper sensor installation, grossly inaccurate sensors, or other system problems. Note that either entering or leaving water temp sensor or the water system could be at fault. * Inverted Water Temp Diagnostic Severity setting determines diagnostic severity and persistence (Warning/ NonLatch; Normal/ Latch).
faultCodes.notes: Severity: Warning/Normal. Persistence: NonLatch/Latch. Active modes [inactive]: Any Ckt Energized [No Ckts Energized]. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.
faultCodes.source: IOM: Series R Heat Pump Chiller Model RTZA (RLC-SVX033A-EN), diagnostics table p.106

faultCodes.code: Low Condenser Rfgt Temp Circuit 1: Unit Off
faultCodes.meaning: This diagnostic is based on dew point from condenser refrigerant pressure transducer of circuit 1 falling below the Condenser Freeze Avoidance Setpoint. When this diagnostic is active, both the Condenser Water Freeze Avoidance Request Relay is turned on and the Condenser Water Pump request is placed in a “Diagnostic Override mode” and forced on regardless of the chiller mode. The diagnostic is auto cleared when both the saturated temperature is 2F (1.1C) above the Condenser Freeze Avoidance Setpoint for 1 minute and the anti short cycling count down calculation reaches 0(see Low Rfgt Condenser Temperature Protection spec), or with the start of either circuit. This diagnostic even while active, does not prevent operation of either circuit.
faultCodes.notes: Severity: Special Action. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: Unit in Stop Mode, or in Auto Mode and No Ckt (s) Energized [Any Ckt Energized]. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.

faultCodes.code: Low Evaporator Refrigerant Temperature Circuit 1: Unit Off
faultCodes.meaning: The respective circuit’s LERTC Integral was seen to be > 0 while the chiller is in the Stop mode, or in Auto mode with no compressors running for at least one minute. The LERTC integral is increased if the Evap Refrigerant Saturated Temp (derived from Evap Shell Pressure) is below the value of the Low Evap Rfgt Temp Cutout + 2°F. Energize Evap Water Pump and Off-Cycle Freeze Avoidance Request Relay until diagnostic auto resets, then return to normal evap pump control and de-energize the Freeze Avoidance Request. Automatic reset occurs when the respective Evap Rfgt Sat Pool Temp rises 4° F(1.1°C) above the LERTC cutout setting for 1 minute and the Chiller Off LERTC Integral = 0.. This diagnostic even while active, does not prevent operation of either circuit.
faultCodes.notes: Severity: Special Action. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: Unit in Stop Mode, or in Auto Mode and No Ckt (s) Energized [Any Ckt Energized]. Reset level: Remote. Table: Main processor diagnostics.

faultCodes.meaning: Evap Refrigerant Saturated Temp (derived from Evap Shell Pressure) for the respective circuit dropped below the Low Refrigerant Temperature Cutout Setpoint for 1125°F-sec (12°F-sec max rate for early circuit startup period) while the circuit was running. The minimum LRTC setpoint is -5°F the point at which oil separates from the refrigerant. The integral is held nonvolatile though power down, is continuously calculated, and can decay or build during the circuit off cycle as conditions warrant.

diagnosticTips: Before resetting, download active and historic diagnostics (with time stamps) with Tracer TU (BAS-SVU047B-EN) or from the display.

Latch diagnostics need a manual reset; NonLatch diagnostics clear when the condition clears. Reset Level is the lowest level of reset that clears it: 'Remote' can be cleared by a BAS or a local reset, 'Local' only at the chiller.
'x' / 'xA' in a diagnostic name stands for the circuit / compressor (1A, 1B, 2A, 2B).

controls.name: Trane RTAG air-cooled helical rotary 085-205 t (50 Hz) diagnostics
controls.description: Diagnostics for RTAG air-cooled helical-rotary chillers 085-205 t, 50 Hz (IOM RTAG-SVX001A-EN, 12/2017). All 149 rows of the manual's diagnostic table(s) are included. Each entry: code = diagnostic name as displayed; meaning = the manual's criteria text (verbatim); notes = affects target, severity, persistence, active modes and reset level as printed. Severity mapping used here: Immediate/Normal shutdown + Latch = lockout, Immediate/Normal + NonLatch = shutdown, Special Action/Mode or Warning = warning, Info = info. Latch = manual reset required; NonLatch = clears when the condition returns to normal. Reset level Local = only a local reset (front panel / Tracer TU) clears it; Remote = local or remote (BAS) reset. Approximate legacy classes: Latch + chiller target ~ MMR, NonLatch + chiller ~ MAR, Latch + circuit ~ CMR, NonLatch + circuit ~ CAR, Warning/Info ~ IFW (interpretation, not a Trane table).

This diagnostic is active only for Y-Delta, Auto-Transformer, Primary Reactor, and X-Line Starters.

faultCodes.meaning: a. No current was sensed on one or two of the current transformer inputs while running or starting (See Non-latching Power Loss Diagnostic for all three phases lost while running). Must hold = 20% RLA. Must trip = 5% RLA. Time to trip shall be longer than guaranteed reset on Starter Module at a minimum, 3 seconds maximum. Actual design trip point is 10%. The actual design trip time is 2.64 seconds. b. If Phase reversal protection is enabled and current is not sensed on one or more current transformer inputs. Logic will detect and trip in a maximum of 0.3 seconds from compressor start.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Cprsr. Severity: Immediate. Persistence: Latch. Active modes [inactive]: Start Sequence and Run modes. Reset level: Local.

faultCodes.meaning: The compressor had previously established currents while running and then all three phases of current were lost. Design: Less than 10% RLA, trip in 2.64 seconds. This diagnostic will preclude the Phase Loss Diagnostic and the Transition Complete Input Opened Diagnostic from being called out. To prevent this diagnostic from occurring with the intended disconnect of main power, the minimum time to trip must be greater than the guaranteed reset time of the Starter module. Note: This diagnostic prevents nuisance latching diagnostics due to a momentary power loss – It does not protect motor/compressor from uncontrolled power reapplication. See Momentary Power Loss Diagnostic for this protection. This diagnostic is not active during the start mode before the transition complete input is proven. Thus a random power loss during a start would result in either a “Starter Fault Type 3” or a “Starter Did Not Transition” latching diagnostic.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Cprsr. Severity: Immediate. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: All compressor running modes [all compressor starting and non-running modes]. Reset level: Remote.

faultCodes.meaning: Detected compressor currents greater than 10% RLA on any or all phases when the compressor was commanded off. Detection time shall be 5 second minimum and 10 seconds maximum. On detection and until the controller is manually reset: generate diagnostic, energize the appropriate alarm relay, continue to energize the Evap Pump Output, and continue to command the affected compressor off, fully unload the effected compressor and command a normal stop to all other compressors. For as long as current continues, perform liquid level, oil return, and fan control on the circuit effected. During contactor interrupt failure, circuit will not be confirmed off, so THR unit sequence should continue running. If THR turns off due to a diagnostic or lockout during contactor interrupt failure, the circuit reverts to air-cooled condenser fan control within 1 second.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Immediate and Special Action. Persistence: Latch. Active modes [inactive]: Starter Contactor not Energized [Starter Contactor Energized]. Reset level: Local.

faultCodes.meaning: The evaporator refrigerant pool temperature measurement is larger than the evaporator entering water temperature by more than 4°C (7.2°F) for 5 continuous minutes. There is an ignore time of 2 minutes following circuit startup. The trip criteria is not evaluated (and time above the threshold is not counted) until the ignore time passes. Invalidate evaporator pool temperature sensor measurement if this diagnostic is active. If evaporator isolation valves are installed, revert to Evaporator Shell Refrigerant Saturated Temperature for freeze protection functions. If evaporator isolation valves are not installed, revert to Evaporator Saturated Temperature for freeze protection functions.

Note: Unlike previous products, even if the circuit associated with the suction pressure sensor is locked out, it will not defeat the protection afforded by this diagnostic.

Automatic reset occurs when both temps rise 2°F (1.1°C) above the cutout setting for 5 minutes, or either circuit starts. This diagnostic even while active, does not prevent operation of either circuit.

faultCodes.code: Low Evaporator Rfgt Temp Circuit 1: Unit Off
faultCodes.meaning: The respective circuit’s LERTC Integral was seen to be > 0 while the chiller is in the Stop mode, or in Auto mode with no compressors running for at least one minute. The LERTC integral is increased if the Evap Refrigerant Pool Temp is below the value of the Low Evap Rfgt Temp Cutout + 2°F. Energize Evap Water Pump and Off-Cycle Freeze Avoidance Request Relay until diagnostic auto resets, then return to normal evap pump control and de-energize the Freeze Avoidance Request. Automatic reset occurs when the respective Evap Rfgt Pool Temp rises 4°F (1.1°C) above the LERTC cutout setting for 1 minute and the Chiller Off LERTC Integral = 0.. This diagnostic even while active, does not prevent operation of either circuit.
faultCodes.notes: Affects target: Chiller. Severity: Special Action. Persistence: NonLatch. Active modes [inactive]: Unit in Stop Mode, or in Auto Mode and No Ckt's Energzd [Any Ckt Energzd]. Reset level: Remote.

The LERTC integral is increased if the Evap Refrigerant Pool Temp is below the value of the Low Evap Rfgt Temp Cutout + 2°F. Energize Evap Water Pump and Off-Cycle Freeze Avoidance Request Relay until diagnostic auto resets, then return to normal evap pump control and de-energize the Freeze Avoidance Request.
